**93% of conservatives who open my emails DON'T respond.**

|
#
Team, I’ve been sounding the alarm bells about Project 2025 for _months_. Project 2025 is the conservative movement’s blueprint for what the second Trump administration is hoping to accomplish. And let me tell you, there is a lot to be concerned about. These plans include:
➡️ Using an 1870s law called the _Comstock Act_ to limit abortion access nationwide
➡️ Eliminating the Department of Education

* Ensuring equal pay for women
* Passing common-sense gun laws
* Protecting our environment from climate change

The attempt to take the life of Donald Trump is a wake-up call for every freedom-loving American. **It's time to _DEFEAT_ the radical ideologies and policies of the Left that are destroying our country.** **[**And there is no better way to do that than by supporting these conservative candidates for the United States Senate:**](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=ab280984b8744d16aa72ee67a4060e5c&_e=-sihdiIVlUTjJCFHxg_Efdt1acNE7YxKqJURDfTmXmpYXQ72o5mwruiwzW8Sx_ylXv6E3r2YI3K5PcxqyUXUZWOKHFQQyLSlCFGKTWwLadQjZ18P7kX9owvBhnexuILzbqiewnoZCC11E8oLCudk_P0-N1_nBr38uJPolvxxszHQ3JHDSYv1AjdWYeoMIHo3fUnIhmbU5Xkr7zKE3Z7XPara9oz9_bP593Q3gG1iYFWUhiUfbuPsUB_jGh-xH5HOYflszFkjakCPc3c2Qoev2Q%3D%3D)**

# [Sick of This Plague](https://public-api.wordpress.com/bar/?stat=groovemails-events&bin=wpcom_email_click&redirect_to=http%3A%2F%2Fbethfarnhamforcongress.com%2F2024%2F07%2F17%2Fsick-of-this-plague%2F&sr=0&signature=ac06d60ce1bff9863053b4c3fadbcbac&blog_id=213069660&user=248418217&_&_z=z)
| | By **Elizabeth Farnham** on July 17, 2024
---|---
_Many thanks to the Gettysburg Connection who published this piece on July 16th, 2024.[https://gettysburgconnection.org/a-plague-of-double-standards/](https://bethfarnhamforcongress.wordpress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=446468e5312588ee805543337c9010cb92b5d13f8f9f62e69a1a930ac2bbe716&blog_id=213069660&post_id=648&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=1729905642584eca8449afea054d535f&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_url=aHR0cHM6Ly9nZXR0eXNidXJnY29ubmVjdGlvbi5vcmcvYS1wbGFndWUtb2YtZG91YmxlLXN0YW5kYXJkcy8)_
As the nation, including much of the press, drills down to every.single.performance. of President Biden in zealous endeavors to gauge his mental acuity, I am constantly reminded of the French fairytale, or nightmare really, “The Animals Sick of the Plague” by Jean de la Fontaine.
If you are not familiar with the story, its premise is that a group of animals who are frightened by a devastating plague, like that of the Black Death, consider who should be sacrificed in order to end it. Starting with the Lion, the “king of beasts,” they each confess their sins until they find the most culpable. Unsurprisingly, the lion’s sins are quite egregious as he admits having eaten scores of sheep, whom he recognizes as having done no wrong, and devouring some of their shepherds too. As awful as his crimes are, however, the Fox, a flatterer of the Lion, forgives him for his transgressions, even going so far as to claim that the sheep and shepherds should have been honored to have been eaten by him. And so the charade continues with each aggressive animal declaring abominable crimes and no one outwardly finding fault with any of their vicious kills, until the Donkey admits to having eaten grass from a monastery yard because once upon a time he was overcome by hunger. The animals leverage his guilt to claim him the most culpable, then sacrifice him.
Sadly today, our nation is in the throes of a plague, albeit no longer a physical one, that continues to sicken many Americans – the plague of Double Standards. A familiar problem to most women, the plague of Double Standards has always been present in our population, but now, it has spread to Democrats, both women and men. While former president Trump is a convicted felon who surrounds himself by cronies in and out of jail, immeasurable scrutiny has landed on President Joe Biden, one of the most successful presidents in U.S. history, because, one time, he had a difficult debate performance.
Through the infestation of Double Standards, no one seems to truly take into account that President Biden had a cold at the time, was on cold medication, or actually presides over our country as a full-time job. Just this week, he gave an impressive speech to NATO. However, a number of Democratic members of Congress have decided that he should simply give up his campaign, while Speaker Emeritus Pelosi keeps claiming that he “should decide,” as if he hasn’t stated unequivocally that he will be the Democratic candidate for President of the United States in November’s election. Moreover, they say next-to-nothing about his opponent in Trump, a wannabe king, convicted of 34 felonies by a jury of his peers, who gish-gallops through lies, each more challenging than the next to counter in a two minute rebuttal. Meanwhile, Fox News pundits flatter convicted felon Trump on his debate performance and his handlers don’t promote his ramblings that the press only resorts to shining more light on President Biden’s imperfections.
But let us consider the other news beyond one halting debate performance from President Biden, a recovering stutterer. Steve Bannon, Trump’s former chief strategist is now in jail for several months for contempt of Congress. Allen Weisselburg, Trump’s former CFO of The Trump Organization, is currently in jail for tax evasion. Peter Navarro, Trump’s Deputy Assistant, is currently in jail for contempt of Congress. Paul Manafort, Rick Gates, Michael Cohen, George Papadopoulos, and Roger Stone are all cronies of Trump who served in his administration, on his campaign(s) or both, have all served time in prison having been convicted of crimes such as conspiracy to defraud the United States and witness tampering, though Trump pardoned a few of them. Recently, Rudy Guliani, former federal prosecutor and Trump’s legal advisor was disbarred due to lying about Trump’s 2020 election loss. Of course, Trump’s charity, The Trump Foundation was shuttered under court supervision due to misuse of funds for political purposes in 2019.
The evidence-based science from our last pandemic makes it clear: if Democrats keep harshly criticizing President Biden for being 81 years old, more American People, of, by, and for whom this Democratic Republic of checks, balances, and sacredness of votes is established, will sicken and die, not only from a disease like COVID-19, but by the the newest mutation of Double Standards that Trump and his court of beasts will unleash upon us should he be re-elected to the highest office of our land.
The moral of the story is: Focus on convicted felon Trump’s crimes, his Project 2025, his January 6th insurrection, and his lies, or President Joe Biden, and hence, our Democracy, will be sacrificed.

Oops - they did it again. Rather than engaging in a genuine discussion of the issues before the voters in NY-21, they launched a legal/administrative assault on my campaign designed to distract me fill my days with responding to something other than campaign business.
There was the [defense of petition signatures](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/eab3a6cb-3fb7-40ee-b2ca-c19d7de72dc7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in early April.
There was the Battle of the Bots that took out my social media and other forms of communication. I wrote about it [here](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/6f629a44-e3c2-43ee-8336-a6796e7bd957?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Curiously, none of the non-Fox progeny ever wanted to pick up on this story. No Rachel Maddow, no Morning Joe, no Lawrence O'Donnell. I suppose they saw it for what it was - a cheap shot.
You may have heard the latest, which is the accusation that I have [misused campaign funds](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/264b9c1e-c7e2-4f89-ae44-54f29727711a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). It's a matter I actually learned about on June 26, 2024 from the NY Post, rather than from the FEC. The NY Post or the New York State Republican Party (or both) violated 52 U.S.C. § 30109(a)(4)(B) and §30109(a)(12)(A) when they made the investigation public. Not only did they make it public - they got it into the papers before I had even received notification of the complaint!
I did not get official notice of the matter until July 13, 2024 - several days AFTER they had published it in the NY Post. On that day, July 13, 2024, I received a letter via email that said, "This matter will remain confidential in accordance with 52 U.S.C. § 30109(a)(4)(B) and §30109(a)(12)(A) unless you notify the Commission in writing that you wish the matter to be made public." The Adirondack Daily Enterprise also carried the story. So much for confidentiality.
I will not go into details - yet. After all, it is a matter that is to remain confidential. Suffice to say that Stefanik's petty complaint underscores her lack of understanding of the challenges of housing in NY-21, as well as the challenges of getting from one side of the district to another. Add to that, the challenges of running an operation on a budget smaller than her $9.8 million campaign budget.
Ridiculous. SUNY Potsdam was forced to close 14 programs in academic year 2023-24 due to a budget shortfall of $9 million.
To reassure you, let me say that my team is addressing the matter, and no - I did not "misuse" campaign funds. If I misused anything, it's my own pocketbook. I have not properly drawn a salary or personal reimbursement from donated funds for expenses I have incurred in operating the campaign. I have retrained from doing so out of a need to be prudent with the small-dollar donations the campaign has received.
I feel an odd sense of empathy to [President Biden in his interview with Lester Holt](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/966570c1-cd90-4d06-b04b-44caf6362354?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
PRESIDENT JOE BIDEN: Sometimes come and talk to me about what we should be talking about.
LESTER HOLT: All right.
PRESIDENT JOE BIDEN: Okay? The issues.
The race for NY-21 will not be won by sparring over administrative details such as signatures, nor remarks edited and taken out of context, nor characterization of funds for one purpose or another.
The issues: universal access to broadband in the North Country; availability of healthcare providers; keeping a robust social security and medicare program; adding benefits to our Veteran's Health Service rather than taking them away; and developing a realistic pathway for legal migrants and asylum seekers. Making sure that women have access to contraception and other forms of healthcare. These are the things we should be talking about.
Tangentially, I need to say that one of my biggest concerns with replacing Biden on the ticket is that this new form of campaigning-by-litigating is certain to snag any new nominee the Dems could come up with. For those squawking about the early-August virtual roll call because they want to continue to shred every syllable uttered by the most successful President in history, did you forget that [we need the early August roll call](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/eb5134e9-9424-4a2b-94a5-c7f3cd5c6c95?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) because Ohio was threatening to kick Biden off the ballot because of the timing of the Democratic National Convention?
Sigh. Catch up on your rest while recovering from Covid, Mr. President. You're going to need it for the remaining days of the campaign.
Meanwhile, back in the North Country, amongst all of the news that could have filled a decade, but which happened only over the course of a week, you may have missed that there were disastrous floods in Lowville and [devastating tornado damage in Rome.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/f416bd51-0f12-475f-87b2-b9fa627e2046?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) What we really should be talking about is how Congress can ensure people get necessary financial relief when climate- and weather-related disasters strike. Or how 'bout just talking about the role Congress should play in mitigating the effects of climate change? Now there's an issue that merits discussion!
I will be in Rome tomorrow, [helping people navigate](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/7b4d2a5e-e7d1-4599-8423-99a003abec28?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) insurance coverage and making sure there are shuttle buses to get from downtown to the shelter and support services at the base. My car is filled with cases of water to distribute. If needed, I'll serve food at the tents set up at Connected Community Schools, located at 207 N. James Street in Rome. BTW - The Red Cross, Oneida County Emergency Services, and several other agencies are available at 364 Hangar Road, Gate 25, in Rome - not too far from where the tornado picked up a B-52 and moved it several feet.
My Republican opponent will be in Milwaukee paying homage to her hero. Are we even sure that Elise is aware that people in her district have lost their homes, or may not have power for 2 weeks or more? With $9.8 million she could even afford to donate a few generators to the elderly.
Here's where my head is right now: I can't parse and analyze every move that is made by "them", nor can I pause to reflect and gain deep understanding of every headline. I wake up. I do what I have to do. I have to have smart feet that can guide me through to November. I feel a deep sense of urgency, step-by-step, to get to the people who need help and to discuss the genuine issues that need resolution.
Smart feet. I gotta keep moving. I hope to see you out on the NY-21 campaign trail.
_If we haven 't met yet, I am Paula Collins, the Democratic and Working Families Party Candidate for New York's 21st Congressional District. Your comments are invaluable to me. Please let me hear from you. Remember that you can always visit my website at www.paulacollinsforcongress.com or by sending me a text at 315-230-3920. _

My car is filled with cases of water to distribute. If needed, I'll serve food at the tents set up at Connected Community Schools, located at 207 N. James Street in Rome. BTW - The Red Cross, Oneida County Emergency Services, and several other agencies are available at 364 Hangar Road, Gate 25, in Rome - not too far from where the tornado picked up a B-52 and moved it several feet. My Republican opponent will be in Milwaukee paying homage to her hero. Are we even sure that Elise is aware that people in her district have lost their homes, or may not have power for 2 weeks or more? With $9.8 million she could even afford to donate a few generators to the elderly. Here's where my head is right now: I can't parse and analyze every move that is made by "them", nor can I pause to reflect and gain deep understanding of every headline. I wake up. I do what I have to do. I have to have smart feet that can guide me through to November. I feel a deep sense of urgency, step-by-step, to get to the people who need help and to discuss the genuine issues that need resolution. Smart feet. I gotta keep moving. I hope to see you out on the NY-21 campaign trail. If we haven 't met yet, I am Paula Collins, the Democratic and Working Families Party Candidate for New York's 21st Congressional District. Your comments are invaluable to me. Please let me hear from you. Remember that you can always visit my website at www.paulacollinsforcongress.com or by sending me a text at 315-230-3920. | | | | | | | (C) 2024 Paula Collins 548 Market Street PMB 72296, San Francisco, CA 94104 ? ?

Dear Peter,

We thought you may be interested to read this CONSERVATIVE NEWS ALERT:
Members of Illinois Delegation Turn Their Backs on Rep. Matt Gaetz During his Primetime Speech at the RNC Convention (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/07/members-of-illinois-delegation-turn-their-backs-on-rep-matt-gaetz-during-his-primetime-speech-at-the-rnc-convention.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=c2f0998234-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D#google_vignette)
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/07/members-of-illinois-delegation-turn-their-backs-on-rep-matt-gaetz-during-his-primetime-speech-at-the-rnc-convention.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=c2f0998234-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D#google_vignette
Members of the Illinois Delegation turned their backs on U.S. Rep. Matt Gaetz (FL-1, R), a close ally of Donald Trump, during his speech Wednesday night at the Republican National Convention in Milwaukee, Wisc. (Anonymous/Illinois Review)

By Illinois Review
The theme at the Republican National Convention taking place this week in Milwaukee, Wisc., has been “unity.” The Republican presidential nominee and 45^th President Donald Trump is expected to triumph unity at his acceptance speech Thursday night. And just as members of the Illinois GOP have fought against Donald Trump every step of the way, tonight their disdain for the MAGA movement was on full display for the world to see as they physically turned their backs on Rep. Matt Gaetz (FL-1, R) during his primetime speech at the national convention.

Gaetz, a close ally of Donald Trump and personal friend of Illinois Congresswoman Mary Miller (IL-15, R), is an outspoken member of the Freedom Caucus who led last year’s ouster (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/10/rep-matt-gaetz-provides-il-gop-with-the-road-map-for-removing-don-tracy-as-party-chair.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=c2f0998234-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) of former Speaker of the House, Rep. Kevin McCarty (CA-20, R, ret.). The ouster was a big upset to establishment Republicans, including McCarthy’s personal friend, Richard Porter, who just finished two terms as the RNC national committeemen from Illinois.

The ouster also paved the way to bringing in the current Speaker, Rep. Mike Johnson (LA-4, R), who is arguably the most conservative Speaker we have had since Newt Gingrinch.

Earlier this year, Speaker Johnson released more than
5,000 hours (https://cha.house.gov/2024/3/committee-on-house-administration-releases-5-000-more-hours-of-january-6-footage?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=c2f0998234-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) of video footage of the U.S. Capitol taken on January 6, 2021. That evidence flipped the Democrat’s “insurrection” narrative on January 6^th. Three weeks ago, the U.S. Supreme Court found (https://www.scotusblog.com/2024/06/justices-rule-for-jan-6-defendant/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=c2f0998234-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) that the U.S. Department of Justice had overstepped its authority by imprisoning hundreds of January 6^th protestors the past three years, reducing the charges to nothing more than trespassing.

https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/07/members-of-illinois-delegation-turn-their-backs-on-rep-matt-gaetz-during-his-primetime-speech-at-the-rnc-convention.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=c2f0998234-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D#google_vignette
RNC Co-Chair Lara Trump addresses the convention on Tuesday night. Members of the Illinois delegation are seated near the center of the convention behind the large Texas delegation. Former White House Deputy Chief of Staff Dan Scavino shown in the foreground. (Scott Kaspar/Illinois Review)

So who are these Illinois delegates who embarrassed our entire delegation during our 15 minutes of national attention? One of them is IL GOP State Central Committeewoman Laura Pollastrini (Dist. 11), who has served as the IL GOP treasurer (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2022/12/according-to-records-il-gop-leaders-give-very-little-money-or-not-at-all.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=c2f0998234-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) since 2022. At the December 10, 2022 State Central Committee meeting in Bolingbrook, Ill., where more than 200 grassroots supporters (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2022/12/il-gop-establishment-rips-mic-away-from-minority-grassroots-leader-during-gop-meeting.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=c2f0998234-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) showed up from all across the state, Pollastrini feverishly kept time during the public comment portion, yelling “Time!” exactly 90 seconds after each grassroot supporter began speaking.

Another person who turned her back on Gaetz is Beth Findley Smith, the estranged wife of State Central Committeeman Larry Smith (Dist. 14), the former chair of the so-called Grassroots Committee (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2022/12/il-gop-disrespects-grassroots-creating-outreach-committee-to-pretend-they-care.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=c2f0998234-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) . Larry Smith gained the attention of Illinois Grassroots supporters when he became one of the deciding votes (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/05/il-gop-grassroots-committee-co-chairs-larry-smith-and-rhonda-belford-disrespect-the-grassroots-and-defend-don-tracy-as-calls-for-their-resignations-grow.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=c2f0998234-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) to keep Don Tracy as Chair last year. Findley Smith is chair of a LaSalle County conservative organization called You Are Not Alone (“YANA”) that has about 2100 members on Facebook.

Gaetz was one of a few who very strongly and publicly endorsed (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=udrZMKMZiac&utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=c2f0998234-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) Darren Bailey over Mike Bost this past primary election for Illinois’ 12^th congressional district. Rep. Mary Miller also came out with a strong endorsement (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/12/breaking-rep-mary-miller-endorses-darren-bailey-in-high-profile-gop-12th-dist-race-cites-faith-driven-service.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=c2f0998234-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D#google_vignette) of Bailey. President Trump maintained his endorsement for Mike Bost, chair of the Veterans Affairs committee, who won the primary.
Tonight at the RNC Convention as Donald Trump Jr. prepares to speak, the iconic photo of his father fist-pumping seconds after surviving an assassination attempt last Saturday night is displayed. (Mark Vargas/Illinois Review)
Donald Trump Jr. addresses the convention on Wednesday night at the Republican National Convention in Milwaukee, Wisc. (Mark Vargas/Illinois Review)

Donald Trump, who survived an assassination attempt (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/07/breaking-trump-shot-at-pennsylvania-rally-stands-up-in-defiance-after-bullet-grazes-his-head.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=c2f0998234-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) last Saturday night in Pennsylvania, is set to take the RNC stage Thursday night to accept the Republican Party’s nomination for President of the United States.

body:
Brace yourself...

Hi friend,
Brace yourself... because you may end up throwing out a lot of the food in your fridge after you finish reading today’s email.
You see, Maryland physician Dr. Brian Paris says many so-called "health foods" are actually the cause of sore, stiff joints that make you feel miserable.
_"If you’re in constant, chronic, excruciating agony and don't feel well, it has to do with what you’re eating... and just as important... what you’re not eating but should eat,"_ says Dr. Paris.
Dr. Paris found certain foods marketed as being healthy...
...actually contain a toxic nutrient your immune system sees as the enemy.
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zkumg8fvekrh0r5ad6j271dg7vs29rnrmvrr52b8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4c9ie6o75clh2bs)
So, every time you take a bite of one of these foods... your immune system unleashes its "army" to attack this nutrient.
And since this nutrient enters your bloodstream once it’s digested... your immune system starts attacking even healthy tissue and organs... **_causing burning in your joints and muscles_**.
Dr. Paris explains, _"Most of my patients assume their joint issues are a normal part of the aging process. They have no idea eating the wrong foods can cause joint problems."_
The good news is... this problem is EASY to fix.
_"You don't have to completely change your diet. Just eliminating_[** __these 5 foods from your diet__**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zug1g7dpc22c3rrr9sscdlf2jq0g1tbd2lq2jc5g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4c9ie6o75clh2bs) _\- including a certain kind of vegetable - will do wonders to your life,"_ he says.
In his entire 20-year career as a doctor, Dr. Paris has found eliminating these 5 foods to be the most powerful drug-free defense against joint problems.
So far, he's helped thousands of people at his private clinic... including some very famous celebrities and NFL athletes.
Now, he's put his list of [**_the 5 worst foods_**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zf2631kc2glpn4dtvhfmqu7q4jkhj25upc5kvl60_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4c9ie6o75clh2bs) (and every other trick he's learned in 20 years) into a free video available to the public..
So far, hundreds of thousands of Americans are feeling much better after following the advice in this video... which is probably why it’s going viral on Facebook.

name: The Babylon Bee
subject: A Special Message from Babylon Bee CEO Seth Dillon
body:
Not long ago, Elon Musk bought Twitter

| | | [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zf4egsolvlipv2ni63p4aeaa0s5n3a69fsk3j5q0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4c9ie6p76c9h2bs)
---
|
---
Friends, Not long ago, Elon Musk bought Twitter, changed his bio to Chief Twit, and sent me a DM that said: “Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor.”
---
[](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zb8ddf1vfhttse9ph8e98n421olv1g3ss185ev50_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4c9ie6p76c9h2bs)
---
| | We've been trying to think of a joke worth $44 billion ever since. But as resourceful and committed to free speech as he is, Musk is still just one man, and X is just one platform. Censorship remains the law of the land on virtually every other social media site run by Big Tech. X is a welcome but rare exception. Just a couple of months ago, I was notified that the conservative David Horowitz Freedom Center was permanently suspended by Vimeo for posting a talk I'd given about censorship. Just think about the irony of that for a second. As if they wanted to make my point for me more emphatically than I ever could, **they censored my talk about censorship. ** **It’s clear to us that what the censors want is submission.** They want unquestioning conformity. They want us to give up and start fighting. Stop telling jokes. Stop telling the truth. They want to raise the cost of speaking freely so high that we'd rather just keep our mouths shut to avoid all the hassle and penalties. They’re asking us if we’re willing to silence ourselves just to make things easier.** ****Our answer to that is NO. The truth is worth it. Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us.**** ** Of course, that's easier said than done. Standing against the censorious Left takes resources. I can tell you right now, The Babylon Bee would not have been able to take the stand that we did against Twitter if it hadn't been for the support of our subscribers.** ** That's our safety net. That's what gives us the confidence to fight back against big tech without being afraid of them putting us out of business. They can hurt us. Sure, they can reduce our reach and smear us in the media, but they can't shut us down. We have our supporters to thank for that. **I hope you'll consider joining the fight by****[**becoming a paid subscriber to the Babylon Bee.**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2za4qqqetostfms5tpq03r1tb2dp3nnb83r0ntpj8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4c9ie6p76c9h2bs)** ** ** But don't just support us. Support defenders of freedom wherever you find them. Subscribe to X Premium to support Elon. Ditch Disney and subscribe to the Daily Wire. Back anyone bold enough to say what's true, even if it comes at a cost. Especially if it comes at a cost. They'll be that much more fearless and that much harder to stop if they have a whole army of freedom-loving subscribers at their backs.
---
[**YES, I'LL STAND WITH THE BEE**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z9grgfqg32636kcehtmgcr0nv0rpe41qjt7kinag_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4c9ie6p76c9h2bs)
---
Thanks for standing with us. We will continue to stand with you. Sincerely,Seth Dillon

Just a couple of months ago, I was notified that the conservative David Horowitz Freedom Center was permanently suspended by Vimeo for posting a talk I'd given about censorship. Just think about the irony of that for a second. As if they wanted to make my point for me more emphatically than I ever could, they censored my talk about censorship. It’s clear to us that what the censors want is submission. They want unquestioning conformity. They want us to give up and start fighting. Stop telling jokes. Stop telling the truth. They want to raise the cost of speaking freely so high that we'd rather just keep our mouths shut to avoid all the hassle and penalties. They’re asking us if we’re willing to silence ourselves just to make things easier. Our answer to that is NO. The truth is worth it. Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us. Of course, that's easier said than done. Standing against the censorious Left takes resources. I can tell you right now, The Babylon Bee would not have been able to take the stand that we did against Twitter if it hadn't been for the support of our subscribers. That's our safety net. That's what gives us the confidence to fight back against big tech without being afraid of them putting us out of business. They can hurt us. Sure, they can reduce our reach and smear us in the media, but they can't shut us down. We have our supporters to thank for that. I hope you'll consider joining the fight by But don't just support us. Support defenders of freedom wherever you find them. Subscribe to X Premium to support Elon. Ditch Disney and subscribe to the Daily Wire. Back anyone bold enough to say what's true, even if it comes at a cost. Especially if it comes at a cost. subject: Pardoned by Trump
body:
I’m asking you to sign this Emergency Pardon Petition

| |

| |
---
Dear Fellow Patriot, As a wrongly accused police officer who was pardoned by President Trump, I’m asking you to sign this **[**Emergency Pardon Petition**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2za544b7n2dt9a435rtllsr04m16pg3n1bi6r6gfg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4c9ie6o73chh2bs)** because right now a decorated police officer is sitting in prison for doing his job. On December 3, 2019, the Kansas City Police Department observed a red pick-up truck chasing another vehicle through the city streets. Officers unsuccessfully attempted to catch the truck – and involved the department’s helicopter to track it. The chopper tracked the car to the backyard of a home – and Detective Eric DeValkenaere and his partner were the first to arrive at the scene. Eric approached the passenger side of the pick-up and his partner approached the driver’s side, both shouting commands at the driver to STOP and SHOW HIS HANDS. Eric saw the suspect reach toward his waistband and grab a handgun, pointing it directly at his partner. Fearing the suspect would shoot, Eric discharged his firearm four times into the windshield of the pick-up as it continued driving into the garage.When officers entered the garage, they found the suspect deceased with his arm hanging out of the window and his .45 semi-automatic pistol on the ground. (A weapon they would later learn was stolen.)No doubt Eric saved his partner’s life that afternoon – and probably his own.**But instead of receiving an award for his heroic actions, Eric DeValkenaere was charged with Involuntary Manslaughter and Armed Criminal Action by a District Attorney desperately trying to hold onto her elected seat on the bench.** Worse, the Missouri Supreme Court just declined to take Eric’s case – exhausting his options through the justice system._Even though the Missouri Attorney General agreed Eric is innocent, woke anti-cop prosecutors and the defund the police mob somehow still won!_**A pardon from Missouri Governor Mike Parson is one of Eric’s last remaining options for freedom.****[Now you know why I’m asking you to follow this link to sign the Emergency Pardon Petition right away.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zf951qvjf8ukmuapkpv18t44sshb2tkrds9gv5n0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4c9ie6o73chh2bs)** My name is Stephanie Mohr and I’m proud to be on the Board of Directors for the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund – a non-profit organization that supports and defends wrongly accused officers like Eric. Over the last few years, LELDF has helped many men and women in blue clear their names and win back their freedom.I am also one of those officers LELDF has helped. You see, I used to be a police officer with the Prince George’s County Police Department in Maryland. Then one night I was called to a burglary scene. I did everything by the book – including releasing my canine to apprehend the suspect. We arrested the suspect, an illegal immigrant who was convicted and deported. So, imagine my shock when five years later the U.S. Department of Justice announced it was indicting me for violating the suspect’s civil rights by allowing my canine to bite and hold his leg so we could arrest him. And after two trials – in which the government flew in two illegal alien criminals to testify against me – I was convicted. I spent ten years in prison. But I was one of the lucky ones – not only did I have LELDF helping me fund and mount my defense – but they also helped me secure a pardon from President Trump restoring my good name.That’s why I can’t turn my back on a decorated police officer with a wife and three children at home waiting for him. **And I hope you won’t either.** **[**Will you sign the Emergency Pardon Petition to Missouri Governor Mike Parson right away?**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zvi4pama48uj7psqeio7mp96t9bc4847rv4cvjd8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4c9ie6o73chh2bs)** Eric should have been commended for his service and life-saving actions that day, not convicted and sentenced to years in prison! The reality is we can’t get back the last several months Eric has been sitting in prison or the nearly four years this nightmare has been hanging over his head.But with your help today, we can bring Eric home to his wife and three children. **[So please, won’t you take just 30 seconds of your time right now to sign the Emergency Pardon Petition to Governor Mike Parson?](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z89s18pcobb82uh7cql3ufq409u47kdj21d0eb00_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4c9ie6o73chh2bs)** After signing the petition, please make a generous donation to LELDF to fund this petition and the legal defenses of eight officers (including Eric) they currently support.Remember, LELDF is able to support wrongly accused and convicted officers like Eric and me because of the generosity of patriots like you. And with a pardon the final option to secure Eric’s freedom and restore his good name, I’m begging you to [**sign the Emergency Pardon Petition today**.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z825nqj56hiou3vfsa778si8pcaqkrsipld5lma0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4c9ie6o73chh2bs)Thank you in advance for your support.
---
| | Gratefully,
---
---
Stephanie MohrDirector, Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund P.S. Without your immediate action, Eric DeValkenaere – a decorated Kansas City Police Detective – will spend the next six years behind bars. His three beautiful children won’t have their biggest cheerleader at their graduations, maybe even their weddings. And the only way to get him out is to get Missouri Governor Mike Parson to pardon him. **[Will you please take 30 seconds right now to sign the Emergency Pardon Petition and help me fight for Eric’s freedom?](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zc8uagjcclnahuub3qebi3nfem5ldc31otid1oag_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4c9ie6o73chh2bs)** I hope you’ll also make a generous, tax-deductible donation to LELDF. body:

This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zegb67rmcto3nk20cmpq3ldark779cf6out2sib8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4c9ie6o74cjh2bs)
---
| |
Dear Fellow American, I hope you’re having a great day. There’s something important I want to share with you today. For years, we’ve seen a growing effort from radical activists to destroy the principles of liberty that have made our nation the freest and most prosperous in history. These radicals have found a willing ally in the Biden administration’s education department. And right now—with the help of these government bureaucrats—they are actively denigrating the U.S. Constitution in America’s schools while teaching destructive ideologies like **critical race theory** and **socialism**. We are at a key point in our history. We **must** defend our nation’s founding documents and principles of liberty through education. And that’s why I’m emailing you today.
---
| | Hillsdale College recently produced a limited number of DVD box sets of our very popular **“Constitution 101”** online course, and I’d like you to have a copy. The course features Hillsdale’s faculty—the same professors who teach our required course on the Constitution on campus. And when you view **“Constitution 101,”** you’ll learn about:
* The original design and purpose of the Constitution.
* The challenges it faced during the Civil War.
* How it has been undermined for over a century by progressivism and liberalism.
* How limited government under the Constitution might be revived in our own time.

---

name: The Babylon Bee
subject: A Special Message from Babylon Bee CEO Seth Dillon
body:
Not long ago, Elon Musk bought Twitter

| | | [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zods3bplrtc0fspn7tlde8qgk23cu0am68qelkdo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4c9ie1or6c3h2bs)
---
|
---
Friends, Not long ago, Elon Musk bought Twitter, changed his bio to Chief Twit, and sent me a DM that said: “Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor.”
---
[](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zeeha0570s3ud6itc41n8me0dt80cc1033ujd7f0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4c9ie1or6c3h2bs)
---
| | We've been trying to think of a joke worth $44 billion ever since. But as resourceful and committed to free speech as he is, Musk is still just one man, and X is just one platform. Censorship remains the law of the land on virtually every other social media site run by Big Tech. X is a welcome but rare exception. Just a couple of months ago, I was notified that the conservative David Horowitz Freedom Center was permanently suspended by Vimeo for posting a talk I'd given about censorship. Just think about the irony of that for a second. As if they wanted to make my point for me more emphatically than I ever could, **they censored my talk about censorship. ** **It’s clear to us that what the censors want is submission.** They want unquestioning conformity. They want us to give up and start fighting. Stop telling jokes. Stop telling the truth. They want to raise the cost of speaking freely so high that we'd rather just keep our mouths shut to avoid all the hassle and penalties. They’re asking us if we’re willing to silence ourselves just to make things easier.** ****Our answer to that is NO. The truth is worth it. Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us.**** ** Of course, that's easier said than done. Standing against the censorious Left takes resources. I can tell you right now, The Babylon Bee would not have been able to take the stand that we did against Twitter if it hadn't been for the support of our subscribers.** ** That's our safety net. That's what gives us the confidence to fight back against big tech without being afraid of them putting us out of business. They can hurt us. Sure, they can reduce our reach and smear us in the media, but they can't shut us down. We have our supporters to thank for that. **I hope you'll consider joining the fight by****[**becoming a paid subscriber to the Babylon Bee.**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zcoqktk4obi2fbssgsi6tf9j194ipd4as7feqgr8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4c9ie1or6c3h2bs)** ** ** But don't just support us. For years, we’ve seen a growing effort from radical activists to destroy the principles of liberty that have made our nation the freest and most prosperous in history. These radicals have found a willing ally in the Biden administration’s education department. And right now—with the help of these government bureaucrats—they are actively denigrating the U.S. Constitution in America’s schools while teaching destructive ideologies like **critical race theory** and **socialism**. We are at a key point in our history. We **must** defend our nation’s founding documents and principles of liberty through education. And that’s why I’m emailing you today.

subject: A Special Message from Babylon Bee CEO Seth Dillon
body:
Not long ago, Elon Musk bought Twitter, changed his bio to Chief Twit, and sent me a DM

| | | [](https://email.alert.freedomandlibertyreport.com/c/eJyMkL9u8yAUR58Gb474czF4YPikyNOXDl06oou5SZDAtjBpm7evXOUBup6fdHT0-7j4C6acltsbFnLXXH3dPZIPGJ55XfpA1H97ySX03PTCetVFx8UYATpywkghR2U57-7OoBzmUQXLzRANgQUxaOKBAFBrG7rkDg83wnIDg4bTFfgsNILVZgQzBgYcM9V2ulaiuBZcYk6BantW2tbaTvNauuzurW07U_-YnJicXqWB6JiZnLaMy87U9GjFF4rpUZg6U8GUmRwOuK-POhNTZ6QXmbFsmG4LU-fp_7sWRo9ddXH7SjmnfTAM-O0Q_Aa0v9306eRPAAAA___yt25s)
---
|
---
Friends, Not long ago, Elon Musk bought Twitter, changed his bio to Chief Twit, and sent me a DM that said: “Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor.”
---
[](https://email.alert.freedomandlibertyreport.com/c/eJyMkL9u8yAUR58Gb474czF4YPikyNOXDl06oou5SZDAtjBpm7evXOUBup6fdHT0-7j4C6acltsbFnLXXH3dPZIPGJ55XfpA1H97ySX03PTCetVFx8UYATpywkghR2U57-7OoBzmUQXLzRANgQUxaOKBAFBrG7rkDg83wnIDg4bTFfgsNILVZgQzBgYcM9V2ulaiuBZcYk6BantW2tbaTvNauuzurW07U_-YnJicXqWB6JiZnLaMy87U9GjFF4rpUZg6U8GUmRwOuK-POhNTZ6QXmbFsmG4LU-fp_7sWRo9ddXH7SjmnfTAM-O0Q_Aa0v9306eRPAAAA___yt25s)
---
| | We've been trying to think of a joke worth $44 billion ever since. But as resourceful and committed to free speech as he is, Musk is still just one man, and X is just one platform. Censorship remains the law of the land on virtually every other social media site run by Big Tech. X is a welcome but rare exception. Just a couple of months ago, I was notified that the conservative David Horowitz Freedom Center was permanently suspended by Vimeo for posting a talk I'd given about censorship. Just think about the irony of that for a second. As if they wanted to make my point for me more emphatically than I ever could, **they censored my talk about censorship. ** **It’s clear to us that what the censors want is submission.** They want unquestioning conformity. They want us to give up and start fighting. Stop telling jokes. Stop telling the truth. They want to raise the cost of speaking freely so high that we'd rather just keep our mouths shut to avoid all the hassle and penalties. They’re asking us if we’re willing to silence ourselves just to make things easier.** ****Our answer to that is NO. The truth is worth it. Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us.**** ** Of course, that's easier said than done. Standing against the censorious Left takes resources. I can tell you right now, The Babylon Bee would not have been able to take the stand that we did against Twitter if it hadn't been for the support of our subscribers.** ** That's our safety net. That's what gives us the confidence to fight back against big tech without being afraid of them putting us out of business. They can hurt us. Sure, they can reduce our reach and smear us in the media, but they can't shut us down. We have our supporters to thank for that. **I hope you'll consider joining the fight by****[**becoming a paid subscriber to the Babylon Bee.**](https://email.alert.freedomandlibertyreport.com/c/eJyMkL9u8yAUR58Gb474czF4YPikyNOXDl06oou5SZDAtjBpm7evXOUBup6fdHT0-7j4C6acltsbFnLXXH3dPZIPGJ55XfpA1H97ySX03PTCetVFx8UYATpywkghR2U57-7OoBzmUQXLzRANgQUxaOKBAFBrG7rkDg83wnIDg4bTFfgsNILVZgQzBgYcM9V2ulaiuBZcYk6BantW2tbaTvNauuzurW07U_-YnJicXqWB6JiZnLaMy87U9GjFF4rpUZg6U8GUmRwOuK-POhNTZ6QXmbFsmG4LU-fp_7sWRo9ddXH7SjmnfTAM-O0Q_Aa0v9306eRPAAAA___yt25s)** ** ** But don't just support us. Support defenders of freedom wherever you find them. Subscribe to X Premium to support Elon. Ditch Disney and subscribe to the Daily Wire. Back anyone bold enough to say what's true, even if it comes at a cost. Especially if it comes at a cost. They'll be that much more fearless and that much harder to stop if they have a whole army of freedom-loving subscribers at their backs.
---
[**YES, I'LL STAND WITH THE BEE**](https://email.alert.freedomandlibertyreport.com/c/eJyMkL9u8yAUR58Gb474czF4YPikyNOXDl06oou5SZDAtjBpm7evXOUBup6fdHT0-7j4C6acltsbFnLXXH3dPZIPGJ55XfpA1H97ySX03PTCetVFx8UYATpywkghR2U57-7OoBzmUQXLzRANgQUxaOKBAFBrG7rkDg83wnIDg4bTFfgsNILVZgQzBgYcM9V2ulaiuBZcYk6BantW2tbaTvNauuzurW07U_-YnJicXqWB6JiZnLaMy87U9GjFF4rpUZg6U8GUmRwOuK-POhNTZ6QXmbFsmG4LU-fp_7sWRo9ddXH7SjmnfTAM-O0Q_Aa0v9306eRPAAAA___yt25s)
---
Thanks for standing with us. We will continue to stand with you. Sincerely,Seth Dillon
CEO, The Babylon Bee

name: Hillsdale College via Restore Our Nation
subject: We are at a critical point
body:
We must defend our nation’s founding documents and principles of liberty through education.

This sponsored message from Restore Our Nation is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/ekTsig_IguNcUs9L09Zp3g~~/AARclAA~~~)
---
| |
Dear Fellow American, I hope you’re having a great day. There’s something important I want to share with you today. For years, we’ve seen a growing effort from radical activists to destroy the principles of liberty that have made our nation the freest and most prosperous in history. These radicals have found a willing ally in the Biden administration’s education department. And right now—with the help of these government bureaucrats—they are actively denigrating the U.S. Constitution in America’s schools while teaching destructive ideologies like **critical race theory** and **socialism**. We are at a key point in our history. We **must** defend our nation’s founding documents and principles of liberty through education. And that’s why I’m emailing you today.
---
| | Hillsdale College recently produced a limited number of DVD box sets of our very popular **“Constitution 101”** online course, and I’d like you to have a copy. The course features Hillsdale’s faculty—the same professors who teach our required course on the Constitution on campus. And when you view **“Constitution 101,”** you’ll learn about:
* The original design and purpose of the Constitution.
* The challenges it faced during the Civil War.
* How it has been undermined for over a century by progressivism and liberalism.
* How limited government under the Constitution might be revived in our own time.

---
| [](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/ekTsig_IguNcUs9L09Zp3g~~/AARclAA~~~)
---
| | **Right now, it can be yours when you make a tax-deductible gift of $100 or more. You can take advantage of this limited-time offer using this secure link:** _[**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/constitution-101-dvd/**](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/ekTsig_IguNcUs9L09Zp3g~~/AARclAA~~~)_ And when you do, you’ll not only get your own DVD box set, but you’ll help expand our national educational outreach efforts such as free online courses, classical K-12 education curriculums, and _Imprimis_ —our digest of liberty. We need your support because we REFUSE all government funding, even indirectly in the form of student grants or loans. **So, please reserve your DVD box set with a gift of $100 or more using this secure link:** [**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/constitution-101-dvd/**](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/ekTsig_IguNcUs9L09Zp3g~~/AARclAA~~~) And remember, as I mentioned above, supplies are limited, so be sure to reserve your copy today. Warm regards, Bill Gray, ’01 Vice President Institutional Advancement Hillsdale College

| | | | "Rumpled." "Disheveled." "Wrinkled." Each morning when I wake up, the first thing on my mind is fighting for Ohioans and the Dignity of Work – not competing for the Senate’s best dressed. That’s why sometimes, “rumpled,” “wrinkled,” and “disheveled” are the words used to describe me. I'm running for reelection to continue fighting for the Dignity of Work – all work. Whether you punch a time clock or swipe a badge, work for tips or earn a salary, are raising children or caring for an aging parent, I'll fight for you. And fighting for all workers doesn’t require the perfect wardrobe. [**_That's why I'm personally asking for your help today, folks. Will you chip in $25 or more now to split between my campaign and No Dem Left Behind so we can win in Ohio and keep the Senate blue? Contributions from grassroots supporters like you are critical to powering our campaign to victory._**](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2u6imd-e4q3yo-kyd76rh9/)

Great Ways to Support
# Mark Robertson for U.S. Congress
By Mark Robertson, Candidate for Nevada's First Congressional District
---
Dear Peter:
Below are just some of the ways that we can get Mark in front of voters. If you have additional ideas or suggestions, please let us know.
1. Tell others about Mark. This can be done face-to-face, over the phone, via email or text, on social media, or any other method. Encourage people to vote for Mark early, in person or by mail. 2. Follow Mark on Facebook. Click here to go to our campaign page: [Facebook](https://dwhdqsbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0012WLqS7CKayozel5FfogcxWONspXlyw6dE7K7HieVkzRDfVFrOhOPZSdpAAYHork6oHzf8D4Ahbt4rwE4Ev5ypBDq377VYhdoaIYbycq-OqyrIuFK8MbwwZe4yw-JNxi7Dfn5yMquJm_N08wZ-F05_251T0obGtbkDTGa83DmOrQ=&c=M1d-B4xQ-CrzXlS7C6MZ1C3VEARBQ00DVBYloXLPGD6ufq8TbJ-3Iw==&ch=e9gSVIZcRIslNg9vP1YnrMXigcPeEXEDSwsMhvrmej5CmcVjdxmBcQ==). When you like a post, you can share it with others by simply hitting the "share" button. 3. Host a Meet & Greet. This is the secret behind Mark's success. When people meet Mark, they vote for him. It is not difficult to host a Meet & Greet. Invite some friends and neighbors over to your house or another meeting place. Mark will come to introduce himself and answer questions. You can sign up for a Meet & Greet at this link: [https://calendly.com/robertson-for-congress/meet-and-greet](https://dwhdqsbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0012WLqS7CKayozel5FfogcxWONspXlyw6dE7K7HieVkzRDfVFrOhOPZaPVuf8-MzupDqEV-vFfwlqUeKaQixMCKtmxdCZY3mKxcJIbyAONidYs3RiXuEyd-GGG-SQVcP9jO9fLy8RiKOJTtkVQv7gEcBDHqknJTyvS871J8iymk3-W3SuMkgapVUYIRlK0B3S5LENIJ5vYHjo=&c=M1d-B4xQ-CrzXlS7C6MZ1C3VEARBQ00DVBYloXLPGD6ufq8TbJ-3Iw==&ch=e9gSVIZcRIslNg9vP1YnrMXigcPeEXEDSwsMhvrmej5CmcVjdxmBcQ==) 4. Install a Yard Sign. Enthusiastic volunteers will install a sign in your yard. Call or text this number and leave a message with your address: (818) 932-8050. 5. Invite Mark as a Speaker. If you belong to a group (Book Club, for example), invite Mark to drop by for a few minutes to introduce himself and answer questions. Call or text this number to check his schedule: (702) 379-5704.
6. Knock on Doors. We'll provide you with a list of registered voters in your area so you can leave some literature at their front door. If you feel comfortable, you could ring the doorbell and tell them about Mark. Call or text Nathan Freed to get a list: (818) 932-8050 7. Make Phone Calls. We'll provide a list of registered voters, their phone numbers, and a simple script. At your convenience, you can call. Most calls go to voicemail, so you can leave a short message encouraging them to vote for Mark. Call Nathan Freed to get a list: (818) 932-8050 8. Make a Financial Contribution. Mark is very frugal, but it still costs money to purchase signs and literature. > Dear Peter, this is Rep. Greg Landsman - Democrat, and J.D. Vance’s representative in Congress. As kids, JD Vance and I grew up near each other in Butler County, Ohio. Now, he’s my constituent in OH-01. And while our paths have crossed in many ways, our visions for our country could not be more different. The recent assassination attempt of former President Trump has made one thing clear: we must come together to oppose the divisive and dangerous agenda he represents. But let me be clear: JD Vance is not a unity selection. Mr. Vance’s track record speaks for itself: [](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tcdb83c40-13fe-4e70-af3f-bad844daf43f/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) It’s the role Vance is playing in fanning the flames of political division that makes him uniquely unfit for this moment of national unity and shared purpose. So, I’m asking for your help. We are locked in a tough re-election battle in a toss-up district Democrats need to hold to keep House control. If Trump & Vance win, that could be our last blue bulwark against a red trifecta in Washington. Your contribution today will help us fight back against the extremism that JD Vance represents. And it’ll show Mr. Vance that he does not represent our values – here in Ohio and across the country. [Peter, can we count on your support today? Please split a donation right now between Blue Amp Action and our re-election campaign to get the word out in Ohio and keep the House blue.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T553b7100-e804-40d2-a5c8-eb5e1bda2332/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Every donation, no matter the size, makes a difference in this critical fight for our future.

body:
Not long ago, Elon Musk bought Twitter, changed his bio to Chief Twit, and sent me a DM

| | | [](https://email.alert.keepcongressrepublican.com/c/eJyMkLturDAURb_GdIz8NhQuru6IJpooXUrrYB8Ya2xANuTx9xHRfEDataWlpf1-czeIKS7zK2S0D19cqQ7QjTB-p3VpR8T2y3HKZUtNyzrHm2BD7zXoBi0znPFedYY1d6uVwonD2AU5cT8ZA73uDEgNOlA0oYn29FDDOtpJpdjFCwTfS4FSocRgiKSQsOyXB-Lm12UuWGvB7RhT9LBc_JqbZO_7vlUi_hE-ED48Q0fEcyZ82BIslYjh2LPLGOKRibhihpgI1yes61E8EnEFfBIPeYM4L0RcX_6_KWY0bYoN22dMKVZ9ds2n4Ddg_9tLH5b_BAAA__9GEG_I)
---
|
---
Friends, Not long ago, Elon Musk bought Twitter, changed his bio to Chief Twit, and sent me a DM that said: “Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor.”
---
[](https://email.alert.keepcongressrepublican.com/c/eJyMkLturDAURb_GdIz8NhQuru6IJpooXUrrYB8Ya2xANuTx9xHRfEDataWlpf1-czeIKS7zK2S0D19cqQ7QjTB-p3VpR8T2y3HKZUtNyzrHm2BD7zXoBi0znPFedYY1d6uVwonD2AU5cT8ZA73uDEgNOlA0oYn29FDDOtpJpdjFCwTfS4FSocRgiKSQsOyXB-Lm12UuWGvB7RhT9LBc_JqbZO_7vlUi_hE-ED48Q0fEcyZ82BIslYjh2LPLGOKRibhihpgI1yes61E8EnEFfBIPeYM4L0RcX_6_KWY0bYoN22dMKVZ9ds2n4Ddg_9tLH5b_BAAA__9GEG_I)
---
| | We've been trying to think of a joke worth $44 billion ever since. But as resourceful and committed to free speech as he is, Musk is still just one man, and X is just one platform. Censorship remains the law of the land on virtually every other social media site run by Big Tech. X is a welcome but rare exception. Just a couple of months ago, I was notified that the conservative David Horowitz Freedom Center was permanently suspended by Vimeo for posting a talk I'd given about censorship. Just think about the irony of that for a second. As if they wanted to make my point for me more emphatically than I ever could, **they censored my talk about censorship. ** **It’s clear to us that what the censors want is submission.** They want unquestioning conformity. They want us to give up and start fighting. Stop telling jokes. Stop telling the truth. They want to raise the cost of speaking freely so high that we'd rather just keep our mouths shut to avoid all the hassle and penalties. They’re asking us if we’re willing to silence ourselves just to make things easier.** ****Our answer to that is NO. The truth is worth it. Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us.**** ** Of course, that's easier said than done. Standing against the censorious Left takes resources. I can tell you right now, The Babylon Bee would not have been able to take the stand that we did against Twitter if it hadn't been for the support of our subscribers.** ** That's our safety net. That's what gives us the confidence to fight back against big tech without being afraid of them putting us out of business. They can hurt us. Sure, they can reduce our reach and smear us in the media, but they can't shut us down. ## Biden Gets Covid as DNC Delays Vote

The drug works by blocking a protein called IL-11, which normally increases with age and is linked to inflammation, muscle wasting, and other age-related issues. ---
This week Vikram released his first quarterly fundraising numbers since entering the race in mid-April.
Despite not having the benefit of a full fundraising quarter, Vikram raised over $400,000!
Not counting candidate contributions, Vikram raised more money in 10 weeks than any of the NH-02 GOP nominees of the past ten years raised during their entire campaigns.
Vikram's Campaign Finance Committee Co-Chair Phil Taub lauded the campaign's success, saying, "Despite not even having a full quarter, Vikram has out-raised candidates who have been raising money for a year, or even longer. His fundraising success is a testament to the strength of his campaign, and he is building a broad coalition of support from all corners of the Republican Party. This is a great first quarter for a Republican primary campaign and proves Vikram will have the resources to win in the fall."
Vikram's fundraising success shows the depth and strength of his support. We are building a strong organization that will be victorious in the fall!

subject: The challenges the Constitution faces
body:
We must defend our nation's founding documents and principles of liberty through education.

This sponsored message from Conservative Liberty Wire is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=0d0589b9fdc44753b6d66574b9cbd31a&_e=rtIdtXRmslows1j_bT2yASb61TL2P5axE1f-MLsp_AJD49Atn0cEhiK854vTQdYEQ_fMxv2H-c5Kf_r5143Q6FfjPJEm4ENcK9CDEAG0vUYwDnF3dNsICbPf8Y4eokS8DLkHSRmL4p4mfxPkeozimQYg4Rvwtif4VcpGyPxyz7thWDau9SYysUS07-9QYNB-aZy2ZDhGg5jBOcduaokILpXDF9djacFU5RMEXsEK_fFebBu7UDU5peEkd4fTsHpJ4WCSeBYZtRTjWK8k0RtwNCQ4_fT9XFAjgAQRZA995E2ur2jrp9oWsgfp4J94zPmVQoj1dqP_Jm3XKZcN9tnjHUJOHAckBrhG4xqo5M72RBFcRJrw42iCPI1_LjrnO1YhkgQuTWoWbaGbMPCCHvd8Cg%3D%3D)

| |

body:
In addition to frequently being the hottest months of the year, July and August share etymological origins: Both are named after Roman rulers. July is named in honor of Julius Caesar, while August is named after his successor and adopted heir, Augustus. # [Two months of the year are named after Roman rulers.](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sgtfxm&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
### [World History](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sgtfxm&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sgtfxm&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
| I n addition to frequently being the hottest months of the year, July and August share etymological origins: Both are [named after Roman rulers](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sgtfxm&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com). July is named in honor of Julius Caesar, while August is named after his successor and adopted heir, Augustus. Born Gaius Octavius in 63 BCE, Augustus was Caesar’s grandnephew on his mother’s side and became the first Roman emperor following his great-uncle’s assassination. Ancient Rome’s influence on the calendar can also be seen in just about every other month: January is named after the god Janus, February comes to us from a purification festival known as Februa, March is named in honor of Mars, June is named for the goddess Juno, and September, October, November, and December had the same names in the Roman calendar. (The names initially corresponded to the months’ position in the 10-month calendar.)
---
These are all found in the Gregorian calendar, which most of the world has been using for centuries. It succeeded the Julian calendar first introduced by none other than Caesar himself in 46 BCE. The Gregorian calendar was formed because the Julian calendar slightly overestimated a solar year as lasting 365.25 days, which eventually led to a discrepancy of 10 days. Pope Gregory XIII decided to do something about it in 1582 — leading to [October 4 being followed directly by October 15](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sgtfxm&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) that year. Time may not be a flat circle, but it’s occasionally open to interpretation.

## The Gregorian calendar differs from a solar year by 26 seconds.
Our current calendar solved the major issues brought about by its predecessor, but it isn’t perfect — in fact, it differs from a solar year by 26 seconds. That’s resulted in a discrepancy of a few hours from when it was originally implemented nearly 500 years ago, but by the year 4909 that difference will have grown to a full day. Because the Gregorian calendar is 26 seconds longer than the solar year, correcting the error will require a day being repeated — perhaps a problem for whoever the pope happens to be some 2,900 years from now.

Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us.

| | | [](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=1006641190b741eca3a2e7bddd470e03&_e=Fq-sps8gMFUz484x0qME1ObJI5JJyvlwohnXKipCLZgFPecz5WHXY6UkcxPJIr7TDE__j4SDPgey82jjH_qvwTnBGxZxrJkxZvbmqTW034nVNa7r8nXB-Y18Q5xth09xDlj-HXWutAae4QCKbQrg6F_jQ6kEYDe0GfVffmW6Fpr2auDhINAhrH-SSdtkLFvdbQGOz8f1m-bQVbDlq8nbDhrJKxS3fcKMhMqKlaoJlJmlfRt7b8c1b4tqdbnStWPWmJpgus3BnVZ_SFSfjDCscg%3D%3D)
---
|
---
Friends, Not long ago, Elon Musk bought Twitter, changed his bio to Chief Twit, and sent me a DM that said: "Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor."
---
[](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=1006641190b741eca3a2e7bddd470e03&_e=Fq-sps8gMFUz484x0qME1ObJI5JJyvlwohnXKipCLZgFPecz5WHXY6UkcxPJIr7TDE__j4SDPgey82jjH_qvwTnBGxZxrJkxZvbmqTW034nVNa7r8nXB-Y18Q5xth09x5-SpEJZxXFXRVSPpX8OlJGZl4OYCDSIvx6yJ37hPOtED7klqT6SpqjPjWIYC3oaJODFldb1LstVALxxz0Y70lmjcJtsDwpIF9SmJijzq7RVL9rIQv87yTLWlwjd5o4lGLGdq9DjdcFhB1mFFSbWxBg%3D%3D)
---
| | We've been trying to think of a joke worth $44 billion ever since. But as resourceful and committed to free speech as he is, Musk is still just one man, and X is just one platform. Censorship remains the law of the land on virtually every other social media site run by Big Tech. X is a welcome but rare exception. Just a couple of months ago, I was notified that the conservative David Horowitz Freedom Center was permanently suspended by Vimeo for posting a talk I'd given about censorship. Just think about the irony of that for a second. As if they wanted to make my point for me more emphatically than I ever could, **they censored my talk about censorship. ** **It 's clear to us that what the censors want is submission. **They want unquestioning conformity. They want us to give up and start fighting. Stop telling jokes. Stop telling the truth. They want to raise the cost of speaking freely so high that we'd rather just keep our mouths shut to avoid all the hassle and penalties. They're asking us if we're willing to silence ourselves just to make things easier. ** ** **Our answer to that is NO. The truth is worth it. Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us.** ** ** Of course, that's easier said than done. Standing against the censorious Left takes resources. I can tell you right now, The Babylon Bee would not have been able to take the stand that we did against Twitter if it hadn't been for the support of our subscribers. ** ** That's our safety net. That's what gives us the confidence to fight back against big tech without being afraid of them putting us out of business. They can hurt us. Sure, they can reduce our reach and smear us in the media, but they can't shut us down. We have our supporters to thank for that. **I hope you'll consider joining the fight by****[**becoming a paid subscriber to the Babylon Bee.**](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=1006641190b741eca3a2e7bddd470e03&_e=Fq-sps8gMFUz484x0qME1ObJI5JJyvlwohnXKipCLZgFPecz5WHXY6UkcxPJIr7TDE__j4SDPgey82jjH_qvwTnBGxZxrJkxZvbmqTW034nVNa7r8nXB-Y18Q5xth09xbASO9WHTNkyu3tak21H1ANFj6REy0bFhiILlOseHAV3v2_w33KxYyKAyFr_JHf8h2WZeAfyxJkWDLtEgzMeo3XxvU91y0PmUyrmkXWqo24r0yMZg18DNiJYKnz20VLpIbZDMMCjqlkin_J1salkpgw%3D%3D)** ** ** But don't just support us. Support defenders of freedom wherever you find them. Subscribe to X Premium to support Elon. Ditch Disney and subscribe to the Daily Wire. Back anyone bold enough to say what's true, even if it comes at a cost. Especially if it comes at a cost. They'll be that much more fearless and that much harder to stop if they have a whole army of freedom-loving subscribers at their backs.
---
[**YES, I'LL STAND WITH THE BEE**](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=1006641190b741eca3a2e7bddd470e03&_e=Fq-sps8gMFUz484x0qME1ObJI5JJyvlwohnXKipCLZgFPecz5WHXY6UkcxPJIr7TDE__j4SDPgey82jjH_qvwTnBGxZxrJkxZvbmqTW034nVNa7r8nXB-Y18Q5xth09xR1kIzKRGFIaTd6Vn81p2Mrm_ElGOLjK6eD12yvnLdFThAOmJPpfAkkJi22peOegvLBU738cEUlSQUidhumpbHyoay9_kZqgz4rY2fA7FgsNkMm2CFMCLU0OJeeq7wi4zis9EyF2FLa235VPL5Y1zQQ%3D%3D)

Thanks for standing with us. We will continue to stand with you. Sincerely, Seth Dillon
CEO, The Babylon Bee

This sponsored message from Defend the Constitution is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=613548599224484587d95c273b75192c&_e=IYYKEYZSlTxWKNnbkWe9g9wQgyZPgNhmZI1D_DMHJi4Ij3YCExhrMgauUtqMZ0dCAfLLzdq_2ABF7hvKAw0ZKwDdVEkJGLjPZDvQsFI3FXzDWAJEutPaFdkR_YI_Pff3cs1dvHaUSaajGbxpCnYCaZJRPl3CrIf03ECsjSY4tYDOMr3tEaXFC5ChIUZdnyfdKyin_OTg1rnxT28EBkb1b7HEoPKMtWl_RgdgSJTzYC6jfloXXxsEImx8X_HKWrRaqPLCVMvrYEutC7TFjsdiNTyOJBt-HBQwvb3Qm9aRfpkRHJM5A0Abb9Hh6Kf-uTu_i8AAXwF2kSDWJfsKn2ZWoyJMBgsilGt3dnuVZncTmxO34gcO91YDKvb90TMy-oKCqGRHumPEH1QRAIcDkEQ6GA%3D%3D)

Dear Fellow American, I hope you're having a great day. There's something important I want to share with you today. For years, we've seen a growing effort from radical activists to destroy the principles of liberty that have made our nation the freest and most prosperous in history. These radicals have found a willing ally in the Biden administration's education department. And right now--with the help of these government bureaucrats--they are actively denigrating the U.S. Constitution in America's schools while teaching destructive ideologies like **critical race theory** and **socialism**. We are at a key point in our history. We **must** defend our nation's founding documents and principles of liberty through education. And that's why I'm emailing you today.
---
| | Hillsdale College recently produced a limited number of DVD box sets of our very popular **" Constitution 101"** online course, and I'd like you to have a copy. The course features Hillsdale's faculty--the same professors who teach our required course on the Constitution on campus. And when you view **" Constitution 101,"** you'll learn about:
* The original design and purpose of the Constitution.
* The challenges it faced during the Civil War.
* How it has been undermined for over a century by progressivism and liberalism.
* How limited government under the Constitution might be revived in our own time.

---

Dear Fellow Believer,

There are so many challenges that missionaries face today:

Language. Culture. Customs. Finances. Housing. Visas. Homesickness.

But at the top of every missionary's list when asked how to help is the need for prayer.

"Please pray for us!" is the plea of missionaries all over the world.

That's because they recognize it is only through God's power that they can overcome the obstacles they face and break through darkness with the light of the gospel.

Praying for missionaries is one of the best things we can do--not just for their sakes, but for ours. When we pray for missionaries, our thoughts are focused on the spiritual needs of people groups all over the world, and our hearts are aligned with God's desire to give them abundant life.
---
[](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=f8d1a9334938455a8975dce497ee8395&_e=NSjYqgOZ4361SmYUKuno1V_ldoejk9u_ScF5HgvPq1A9CJ7wwZbZvv4gNOX16L1zCEiNLM9qTvFkcY6T1YN1a6sxO1xBQ3ZQC1C-n98Z-_QVJY8GoGGXAO_08h1-ZzodP5XWqb2SWI71rhhp0fLPD-7BqWQwmRDNuzsHbfU3-6ldawnTTUSjmuqCGkjFaZOA7S5WYC4vo546jmB3oSEOiXZX8B2sGJ5zOKiMhh1VU3kRMqapuISxIfui-JhAMXg8hvQe2e7fFDS2Io503eZIbCw6rWwduVFksAJw3JSrgD7r66pdKCFOIQUz8171DozZtJHuwrT-MDlMAYJxsoHoTPqz3UPpo8YjgwfCkzrlnZZgVAgxCMgwYSxeKziGcZF7)

If you can spare a few moments each day for one week to lift up the needs of men and women who are bringing the gospel to unreached areas, we would be so grateful!

For the next seven days, we'll send you an email telling you about specific missionaries to pray for and the ministry they are doing. Will you help in this way?

**If so, go here to start receiving prayer requests in your inbox for the next seven days:** [https://welcome.imb.org/pray_for_missionary_lp.html](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=f8d1a9334938455a8975dce497ee8395&_e=NSjYqgOZ4361SmYUKuno1V_ldoejk9u_ScF5HgvPq1A9CJ7wwZbZvv4gNOX16L1zCEiNLM9qTvFkcY6T1YN1a6sxO1xBQ3ZQC1C-n98Z-_QVJY8GoGGXAO_08h1-ZzodP5XWqb2SWI71rhhp0fLPD-7BqWQwmRDNuzsHbfU3-6ldawnTTUSjmuqCGkjFaZOA7S5WYC4vo546jmB3oSEOiUBVuw3b-hNXwMiQBu5K_yD46RW2kpgBk4rLWFDIJiIK_-T1VCYUZaL_ovxiYSglTj2wEuyNg7mRKPTHT0VGNB7fXEp4zh93ktRF-Vxk3xWtlj3rIunJgHlzSZ8H7V2ODti3pwZRccpC0HNeMMWZGCbSO9FDhUxoeTV3GkvX2eNR)

On behalf of the missionaries that you will be praying for this week, thank you! Your prayers are more valuable than you might realize!

God bless you,

Emily Hall

subject: A Special Message from Babylon Bee CEO Seth Dillon
body:
Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us.

| | | [](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e7a08f7891b049cc8dd7ba932b01b96f&_e=Le7_eehcOMABv78HePmqOdMM7x_bZ_Xn-GbQGo7CyJtwPgUD0F3CpLTPWeaAZ2imrhJ8MilYuC6GWa7JjH4_Abo78UpS2TR59OcQBVEAViTLQOO0MkrkZIx8e3AscV1XSh2hE84EPFCxMQ1uw4flR7kJDFXMInZWx_ZCjfvH8nsTsVbJ4V0TjELauCTh47i1lfSw2qv6oMeiERBCKaQl8I-M0JsNxWPS6UlssFi6gdv39zuE1dZTFcX2tOb8a8ymt4SLGNpLhmC7D4Q8OoibXw%3D%3D)
---
|
---
Friends, Not long ago, Elon Musk bought Twitter, changed his bio to Chief Twit, and sent me a DM that said: "Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor."
---
[](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e7a08f7891b049cc8dd7ba932b01b96f&_e=Le7_eehcOMABv78HePmqOdMM7x_bZ_Xn-GbQGo7CyJtwPgUD0F3CpLTPWeaAZ2imrhJ8MilYuC6GWa7JjH4_Abo78UpS2TR59OcQBVEAViTLQOO0MkrkZIx8e3AscV1Xc_2D--DvJ9890cz4loyb1p92dbJY7aSFaYY8nJUn9yocwChJwGf70tliPl_8aSaH47M9OQqUyx9OApSzdzrx94A68WChnKLqX48bCGGisBnWYZUcIi6WbHeM49MmUk5p8uOiu0j2zXGsHRiL47aoww%3D%3D)
---
| | We've been trying to think of a joke worth $44 billion ever since. But as resourceful and committed to free speech as he is, Musk is still just one man, and X is just one platform. Censorship remains the law of the land on virtually every other social media site run by Big Tech. X is a welcome but rare exception. Just a couple of months ago, I was notified that the conservative David Horowitz Freedom Center was permanently suspended by Vimeo for posting a talk I'd given about censorship. Just think about the irony of that for a second. As if they wanted to make my point for me more emphatically than I ever could, **they censored my talk about censorship. ** **It 's clear to us that what the censors want is submission. **They want unquestioning conformity. They want us to give up and start fighting. Stop telling jokes. Stop telling the truth. They want to raise the cost of speaking freely so high that we'd rather just keep our mouths shut to avoid all the hassle and penalties. They're asking us if we're willing to silence ourselves just to make things easier. ** ** **Our answer to that is NO. The truth is worth it. Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us.** ** ** Of course, that's easier said than done. Standing against the censorious Left takes resources. I can tell you right now, The Babylon Bee would not have been able to take the stand that we did against Twitter if it hadn't been for the support of our subscribers. ** ** That's our safety net. That's what gives us the confidence to fight back against big tech without being afraid of them putting us out of business. They can hurt us. Sure, they can reduce our reach and smear us in the media, but they can't shut us down. We have our supporters to thank for that. **I hope you'll consider joining the fight by****[**becoming a paid subscriber to the Babylon Bee.**](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e7a08f7891b049cc8dd7ba932b01b96f&_e=Le7_eehcOMABv78HePmqOdMM7x_bZ_Xn-GbQGo7CyJtwPgUD0F3CpLTPWeaAZ2imrhJ8MilYuC6GWa7JjH4_Abo78UpS2TR59OcQBVEAViTLQOO0MkrkZIx8e3AscV1XzEaBIg2WsbEeMXNSaiJ_TbqqAmZxagtRCB5N12ehUuBUfb02WM5oHpjNvcveTUDwYADGDxKpXmPV46ub3SGLaN7So6H7ygA5bNxXw7ppiw7fcXVoowuVYDHyegX_H4Q566TLaHmIBV6GzkFwSd4EiA%3D%3D)** ** ** But don't just support us. Support defenders of freedom wherever you find them. Subscribe to X Premium to support Elon. Ditch Disney and subscribe to the Daily Wire. Back anyone bold enough to say what's true, even if it comes at a cost. Especially if it comes at a cost. They'll be that much more fearless and that much harder to stop if they have a whole army of freedom-loving subscribers at their backs.
---
