name: Heidi Ganahl
subject: The Mountain Minute: 7/18/2024
body:
Your daily rundown of REAL news for REAL Coloradans.
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi everyone!
The past couple of days at the RNC was truly remarkable and left us all feeling inspired! Vivek Ramaswamy's speech was a standout moment—his passion and vision for our country had everyone jumping out of their seats in applause. The day was further highlighted by the powerful stories shared by two incredible mothers who bravely spoke about their experiences. Their strength and dedication resonated deeply with us all, reminding us of the common values that unite us as Americans. Yesterday, I was also fortunate to discuss these very issues on the Mandy Connell show, highlighting the need for such a strong platform such as Rocky Mountain Voice in the politically radical landscape of Colorado. I am thrilled to be united in freedom with you!
This is the Mountain Minute for Thursday, July 18, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl, from the Republican National Convention in Milwaukee
---
|
---
| | **TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
---
**[Adversaries turned allies tell RNC Trump is right for job, Biden right for “Weekend at Bernie’s”](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_Actions speak louder than words and on the second evening of the Republican National Convention in Milwaukee, Wisc., a few of former President Donald J. Trump’s rivals acted through their words._
_Ron DeSantis, Nikki Haley and Vivek Ramaswamy, who offered Mr. Trump the greatest challenge in the primary season, joined with his toughest competition from the 2016 primary, Sen. Ted Cruz, as an expression of the party coalescing around Trump._
_“Never before has an election mattered so much,” Cruz said._
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**MANDY CONNELL ON THE STREET AT THE RNC**
**[07-17-24 Interview - Heidi and Harvey Ganahl On What It's Like To Be Delegate](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) []()** [THE MANDY CONNELL PODCAST](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
**[LISTEN HERE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**RNC COVERAGE**
**[Colorado Republicans praise Trump’s pick of ‘young, dynamic’ J.D. Vance as his running mate](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)[]()** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). STATE
* Colorado Republicans enthusiastically supported Donald Trump's choice of Senator JD Vance as his vice-presidential running mate, viewing it as a move to empower a new generation within the party.
* GOP leaders and delegates in Colorado highlighted Vance's alignment with Trump's America First policy and praised his potential to invigorate the party.
* The selection drew criticism from Colorado Democrats, who challenged Vance's policy positions, while Republicans anticipate he will positively impact Trump's campaign.

|
---
**[Platform focuses on ‘forgotten men and women of America’, Sen. Blackburn reports](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)[]()** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Senator Marsha Blackburn presented a 20-point Republican platform at the National Convention, focusing on border security, economic issues like ending inflation, and enhancing American energy independence.
* Key platform initiatives include addressing crime, dismantling drug cartels, strengthening the military, and cutting funding for Critical Race Theory and gender ideology.
* Blackburn criticized Biden's tax policies and pledged that a Trump administration would make previous tax cuts permanent and significantly reduce IRS staffing.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**STATE AND LOCAL**

**[Gaines: Is Gov. Polis sending homeless people to my hometown? Fact check finds no support to claim](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) COMMENTARY
_I was talking to a friend the other day and he remarked that his neighbor had told him that Gov. Polis was sending homeless people out to Sterling, Colo._
_It got me curious. I do know that I’ve seen more homeless people out here than when I first moved out, but are there a ton more? Are they coming from Polis?_
_I’ll get to the answer in a sec, but I wanted to take this as an opportunity to discuss (yet again) the importance of skepticism when you hear a claim. I wanted to take this as an opportunity to provide an example of some simple steps you can take to evaluate claims you hear._
_**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**_
|
---
**[Teacher’s alleged Trump post does not speak for district, Jeffco schools say](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [KDVR](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* A teacher previously listed at a Jeffco elementary school is confirmed to still be employed by the district but no longer works at that school.
* Colorado State Rep. Steven Woodrow attracted attention with a controversial post on X regarding an assassination attempt on Donald Trump, which he later deleted.
* After deleting his X account, Woodrow issued a statement condemning the assassination attempt and apologized for his earlier post.

|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️**
**[Ganahl: A look at J.D. Vance, Trump’s vice-presidential candidate, a Marine veteran and first Millennial on a major-party ticket](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY HEIDI GANAHL** **| COMMENTARY | JULY 16** []() ___When former President Donald J. Trump announced U.S. Sen. J.D. Vance, R-Ohio, would be his vice-presidential running mate on the Republican Party’s presidential ticket, it concluded months of speculation._ __
**[‘The devil came’ but ‘the lion roared’, Sen. Tim Scott says in energizing address to RNC](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY JOHN FABBRICATOR | NATIONAL | JULY 16** _Until former President Donald J. Trump arrived in the arena Monday, the most applause on the opening night at the Republican National Convention in Milwaukee, Wisc., was reserved for one of his primary opponents, Sen. Tim Scott of South Carolina._
**[Fabbricatore: A law enforcement leader’s perspective on the assassination attempt on President Trump](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY JOHN FABBRICATOR | COMMENTARY | JULY 15** _Have you ever experienced a situation where things happen that are done right, but still go horribly wrong? The recent assassination attempt on President Donald Trump’s life is a stark example of this._

Dear Peter,
We are very grateful for President Trump’s safety after the shocking assassination attempt. In response to this event, Homeland Security Secretary Mayorkas announced on Monday, July 15, that President Biden had **extended Secret Service protection to Robert Kennedy Jr.**
This long-overdue decision is a step towards restoring fairness and ethics in our politics.
**Hope Must Supersede the Politics of Hate and Fear**
For decades, U.S. political rhetoric has been driven by fear of the other party. Each party has accused the other of threatening to destroy the republic and democracy. Alternating power, the Democratic and Republican parties tend to govern unilaterally rather than collaboratively, fueling animosity and cycles of vitriol.
Unless we change course, the violence of this past week may be an ominous sign of what’s to come. We must embrace our disagreements without being disagreeable. **Political violence is unacceptable and must never replace a respectful, civil, and democratic culture.**
From the outset, Robert F. Kennedy Jr.’s campaign has aimed to "Heal the Divide." Kennedy has focused on the values that unite us rather than the issues that drive us apart. He has refused to bash his opponents while advocating for the restoration of an exemplary America.
Let us hope political leaders and observers recognize RFK Jr.'s wisdom.
**Secret Service Protection Brings New Visibility to Kennedy's Campaign**
With Kennedy receiving Secret Service protection, many Americans learned of his candidacy for the first time. The shifting political landscape has made voters eager for an option outside the broken two-party system. According to Gallup, 51% now identify as “independent,” and Kennedy leads this rising independent majority. Furthermore, 60% would vote for a moderate independent candidate over Biden or Trump, according to the latest Harvard Harris poll.
**Time to Act**
**Help us seize the moment.** Let's spread Kennedy's message to every voter hungry for the historic shift from division to unity, from the dark valley of hatred and distrust to the bright summit of national purpose.

I’ve got no business running for the U.S. Senate – and that’s exactly why I am. = Hey there, My name is Dan Osborn, and I am the candidate running for U.S. Senate against Republican Deb Fischer here in Nebraska. I know what you’re thinking. I get a lot of eye rolls when I say the word Nebraska and tell people that I’m running against a Republican. A lot of people don’t think we can win against a two-term incumbent who has an (R) next to her name. But give me the chance to explain why they’re wrong. The people of Nebraska are ready for change. A brand-new poll shows just 24% of Nebraskan voters approve of Republican Deb Fischer – and in that same poll, I am LEADING by 2 points! Seriously. Nebraskans are fed up with Washington. Both parties – Democrats and Republicans – are full of too many people that have been bought and paid for by corporations and billionaires. The Republicans don’t look out for blue-collar working people like me, and too many Democrats in DC don’t seem to understand rural America anymore. I’m not rich, and I don’t come from some political dynasty. I’ve got no business running for the U.S. Senate – and that’s exactly why I am. I am a proud card-carrying steamfitter and mechanic. Fellow American,

On Tuesday evening, I spoke at the Republican National Convention. But before I took to the stage, **I wrote to you that I had made a bet with my team that we could raise $15,000 before I delivered my speech.**

_**I lost that bet.**_ When I stepped off the stage at the RNC, I was told that we still hadn’t hit our $15,000 goal for the day. To add insult to injury, we couldn’t even make up lost ground over the past 36+ hours, either.

While I was confident we would surpass the goal we set BEFORE I spoke, there’s more work to be done.

# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1661%2E135344%2ECu6aUO)

Friend,
This week we launched a new TV ad, our third of this campaign. You can watch it here:
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-july24-tvad.OPKSca&refcode=em240718-1-400&t=2&akid=1661%2E135344%2ECu6aUO)
**[WATCH NOW](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-july24-tvad.OPKSca&refcode=em240718-1-400&t=3&akid=1661%2E135344%2ECu6aUO)**
If you’ve seen our other ads so far -- and hopefully you have -- you might notice that this one is a little bit different.
You see, it’s about the reason I first ran for Congress, and what drives my work today: my mom. But it could have been anyone’s mom. She had survived breast cancer when I was very young, and her pre-existing condition hung over all of us. She lost her job and couldn’t afford health insurance -- and then she was diagnosed with stage IV ovarian cancer.
It was like a grenade went off in our lives. As my mom fought the disease, we fought the insurance companies and drew up bankruptcy papers.
The ad is about my mom’s story, but it’s also about the moment I decided to run for office and the duty that elected officials owe their constituents. In 2017, when I saw my then Congressman on the White House lawn, grinning at a celebration of the House repeal of the Affordable Care Act, which would have eliminated protections for people like my mom, something inside me broke. So I ran against him, and in 2018 we fired him as our Congressman.
That moment and the experience of getting my mom the care she needed are why I first ran, and they’re why I fight today.
This ad is also a little different because it’s a full 60 second ad, when most of the ads campaigns run are 30 seconds. We did this because it’s important that we tell voters the full story of who I am and why I am running, but this ad being twice as long also makes it twice as expensive.
[**So, if you’d like to help her story reach as many Michiganders as possible, I hope you’ll consider chipping in to my campaign today. Every little bit helps.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-july24-tvad.OPKSca&refcode=em240718-1-400&t=4&akid=1661%2E135344%2ECu6aUO)

I hope you're having a great day so far. I'm reaching out to share something important with you...something that could expand your horizons. I'm talking about studying American history! As Hillsdale College professor Wilfred McClay explains in our online course ["The Great American Story: A Land of Hope,"](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=d98a00a5ecdd41929f9dfa33d0f4a6e2&_e=bkg1eMnTG1T9-QzciyWvggZbpcjOCWbpNH4NPAOP2yG_ZqBwXqh0MdZb-arglUsYZCyitx3XgzrIfGhaURKqSncullVU-BPmSmteBZapV28Y-locZ-TGs2NHxqBVg9uz_fm2sczd_ZHxmXK70pCQIaBiA-Vwn1z9XZBbsQSGYuXxXrPPpTUXLi9RmAlGCwIxyK7MESzAh2IoXqHjJWk-HSXDbsFdvRJ-tNE1YVdXVCEe6aBUWILO8Ns_mYYRfq3H4nMqpdBFlV3ST1oZ9wK4d9OBZvBlwYlCwy2mmpr84s49SzpISXgSTzlSnwYsmzWh7TtbclNtLtgpnofPSxg2fu7xEEeeaKbiuqBXTP5nN0Dgl_l7cw5-xuP87RYkqRrmVhHyZMY9xGIKakJXz6AshMgYSNSMAQTiEEuwBzQisEg%3D) studying history can broaden your perspective and help you understand different ways of living. Compare that to _The New York Times '_ "1619 Project," now a multi-part series streaming online. The "1619 Project" locates the founding of America in 1619, the year the first slave arrived on our shores, rather than in 1776, when the **Declaration of Independence declared that all men are created equal with unalienable God-given rights**. According to the "1619 Project," the key to understanding America is not freedom but slavery--and the project's main goal is to broadcast this false teaching into every home, including yours. We must counter this false and dishonest historical narrative with the truth. **That 's why we've turned our online course, ["The Great American Story: A Land of Hope,"](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=d98a00a5ecdd41929f9dfa33d0f4a6e2&_e=bkg1eMnTG1T9-QzciyWvggZbpcjOCWbpNH4NPAOP2yG_ZqBwXqh0MdZb-arglUsYZCyitx3XgzrIfGhaURKqSncullVU-BPmSmteBZapV28Y-locZ-TGs2NHxqBVg9uz_fm2sczd_ZHxmXK70pCQIaBiA-Vwn1z9XZBbsQSGYuXxXrPPpTUXLi9RmAlGCwIxyK7MESzAh2IoXqHjJWk-HSXDbsFdvRJ-tNE1YVdXVCEe6aBUWILO8Ns_mYYRfq3H4nMqpdBFlV3ST1oZ9wK4d9juCEM1OUTZ3Ax3OyxvEODvwdjPxXt3FdoFmlGMVINpI5amXEzefTm6dqjOZL9aW-o-AV1dnOHXhOuPu1BgNbLMBTGuHNOWsCtG7cLy19tIRqu6GRPkS9lc8rr7FrqMHnonluJ1NSMNrjPF1NrtZXM%3D) into a DVD set, and I'd like you to have a copy.** **" The Great American Story: A Land of Hope"** presents a full, unbiased account of America's past. We produced this course to restore the kind of intelligent patriotism--especially among our young people--essential to restoring free government. You'll be excited to learn that **" The Great American Story: A Land of Hope"** is a powerful counterweight to _The New York Times '_ "1619 Project," which tells people, especially children, that America is essentially an unjust nation--the opposite of our nation's unifying principles. Today, you can claim a DVD copy of ["The Great American Story: A Land of Hope"](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=d98a00a5ecdd41929f9dfa33d0f4a6e2&_e=bkg1eMnTG1T9-QzciyWvggZbpcjOCWbpNH4NPAOP2yG_ZqBwXqh0MdZb-arglUsYZCyitx3XgzrIfGhaURKqSncullVU-BPmSmteBZapV28Y-locZ-TGs2NHxqBVg9uz_fm2sczd_ZHxmXK70pCQIaBiA-Vwn1z9XZBbsQSGYuXxXrPPpTUXLi9RmAlGCwIxyK7MESzAh2IoXqHjJWk-HSXDbsFdvRJ-tNE1YVdXVCEe6aBUWILO8Ns_mYYRfq3H4nMqpdBFlV3ST1oZ9wK4dxC-6fTamtVGyHPrQVBbqWhhajxaJ5pNDqufyra5v2lXRB-AcJ3eBe5ZBg-k6RO2gZ_DvS7gnZxbIScQqI2ThfbfW-CNi4l9rdiglmLfRgOWFRnfhOmCb0M9KYoiMhMVL4e0_PzA-4aQKadzRnfHx7k%3D) for your home library or give it as a gift. **Presenting real American history is the surest means of preserving liberty.** Quantities are limited, so reserve your copy today. Fellow American,

**President Trump just announced that my friend and colleague, JD Vance, will be his next Vice President when he wins back the White House on November 5th!**

From my personal experience working with JD, I know that he’s the right man for the job. [**Before you read why he’s the right choice, will you chip in a few bucks to my campaign to capitalize on this great momentum for the MAGA movement?**](http://links.houseconservatives.org/u/click?_t=a828c22267f2452d9c778060a3aea04e&_m=e3397c0f1a2842b582f800370d277dfa&_e=ShPm4PsRxgZ2W9_nYJhd7xf_K5nvYMApyrvNZhvhzbty1iEExq4T9isiX5yt_to9v9iZ021IvNPZhQ-GtdtTXlcWVBf7wl4fhIILD0ha3f5NKb6OuV581jBRHv-zUerfGHVfWIvpo5VC2AR9EPSTF8Rw04Y08sJQ0n_WWT_dV_JGiWKC2LXhAi2hKPrzSNs6CEXjzQcQmKibld5CzntgACUO_D5PbYPHPATVwfUR7YOqs958e7YsLRGBFztrzbGkTf0zRMVOrrzMFdeCbYSHHNJY3hu0zJktjNuP-mmh5gqXVJKpfk4AzpxovurwhSJ23GHK7d8hJ5vnNgUC3GvkSQ%3D%3D)

I’ve worked with JD on not one but TWO major bicameral bills in the last year. We worked together on the Withholding Illegal Revenue Entering Drug Markets (WIRED) Act, which aimed to tax wire transfers from the Drug Cartels, and we worked on passing a bill that would guarantee a clean, un-offset Israel aid package. Without getting too in the weeds on policy with you, I was proud to work with JD on immigration and Israel, respectively. I know that he’ll continue to fight for both issues, plus many more, as Vice President.

Furthermore, when I opened the Republican Study Committee (RSC) to Senate Offices, JD was one of the first Senators to join. He has been an essential partner in expanding bicameral relationships among conservatives. His commitment to the Republican Party is proven and unmatched.
| [ **SUPPORT REPUBLICANS** ](http://links.houseconservatives.org/u/click?_t=a828c22267f2452d9c778060a3aea04e&_m=e3397c0f1a2842b582f800370d277dfa&_e=ShPm4PsRxgZ2W9_nYJhd7xf_K5nvYMApyrvNZhvhzbty1iEExq4T9isiX5yt_to9v9iZ021IvNPZhQ-GtdtTXlcWVBf7wl4fhIILD0ha3f5NKb6OuV581jBRHv-zUerfGHVfWIvpo5VC2AR9EPSTF8Rw04Y08sJQ0n_WWT_dV_KzweojN_G2uPBipWT9S3ylJH5jXmr5LJhB9YlBlqbwPPKX5XHDu1qP2mv4BVTiNgBuNAByP3f93isCfraGD-NmgO5mZN9TRcN1rUOh4phucjdCkWghmbefuA8GEJBVi6ZqXc0wNJJa1_HpJ9-XhYeYyQcN7Ld1zW_onxMCTR-qtg%3D%3D)

body:
| | | Peter, **Knock, knock, knock. ** _It’s the scariest sound you’ll hear when you live in a communist country. _ _It’s the last sound my parents heard when their fathers were taken away. _ _It’s the sound of always living in fear, and it’s my family’s real-life story. _ We escaped from Vietnam just days before Saigon fell to the communists, and we were given a new life in the most generous country on Earth. My name is Hung Cao, and America saved my life. From a young age, I knew I wanted to pay back this country for all it had done for me. I graduated from the United States Naval Academy and served for 25 years in Navy Special Operations in Iraq, Afghanistan, and Somalia. Now, today, I’m the Republican nominee for the United States Senate in Virginia. **[**Only in America can a little boy who fled communism grow up to address the Republican National Convention, but today, I stood on the stage and told my story. **](http://links.hungcaoforva.com/u/click?_t=c514f30bd6cd4b1bb0e09a0456675c53&_m=0dcd69c75c2643e0b0dd80e9a598e749&_e=UlV9FTKA5Ti9jB9EGnT9CEgPdxMelmSURVFx4TnaoruFaSC1_tDyE-VSkGGVAW-8vtdE7coRh7ChZQ3c9XyMYhYabJY9i9m4PTm7RgjIrs9NoPZ-te9bo3cx1YaeX8LT4nXBg0xLq2FladQKCPqOiB9KGdVJnV6VTPbYA05MDihIKOnE2sHPpOGOfpQ0wN4oCUxlr7Nd8f4pjMgLis7OyjDcMFtareVBI6LciFjUp-oi3A-rTgdL8RFVLoP_nMQf682YnSWqB2r4kVR2wnaGDBtuWLhNdiJ54F7WjYPXwxGaaAG3LEBIl9vwMUkmRdtZtPqIfYQNzg4Njuq9oL19EOoKo3ewZC7w_O1x-Kc0rWQ7yHlODhNa8Aoaf6biUWoN)**

clean_body: | | | Peter, Knock, knock, knock. It’s the scariest sound you’ll hear when you live in a communist country. It’s the last sound my parents heard when their fathers were taken away. It’s the sound of always living in fear, and it’s my family’s real-life story. We escaped from Vietnam just days before Saigon fell to the communists, and we were given a new life in the most generous country on Earth. My name is Hung Cao, and America saved my life. From a young age, I knew I wanted to pay back this country for all it had done for me. I graduated from the United States Naval Academy and served for 25 years in Navy Special Operations in Iraq, Afghanistan, and Somalia. Now, today, I’m the Republican nominee for the United States Senate in Virginia. I love this country, but right now, we’re losing it to Joe Biden and the radical Left. Our border is wide open, and American families have paid the price with violent crime and even the lives of their loved ones. Look, I’m an immigrant myself, but my family and I came here the right way, and we obeyed American laws and embraced the American culture. That’s not what’s happening today. I love this country so much that I wrote a blank check up to and including my life for it. In November, I know we can win this race, re-elect President Trump, and SAVE AMERICA! My military career may be over, but I’m far from done fighting for this country. In Liberty, CAPT Hung Cao USN (Ret) | | Paid for by Hung Cao for Virginia | | Use of military rank, job titles, and photographs in uniform does not imply endorsement by the Department of the Navy or the Department of Defense.

Look, the GOP knows this race could determine Senate control — and now that Rick Scott has thrown his hat in the ring to replace Mitch McConnell, **it could also determine the next Senate majority leader. **

Now, more than ever before, it’s critical that we protect our Democratic Senate majority.

# Will you join us?
---
---
Greetings! Many of you have expressed concerns about the danger posed by our opponents and questioned whether now is the time for transformative change in electoral politics. We hear you, and we understand the urgency. We believe running a strong, independent campaign and systemic change go hand in hand. In fact, **they are intrinsically linked.** Our campaign stands for raising overlooked issues, breaking free from the corporate duopoly, and advocating for the poor and working class. **The power to force change is in and with the people** —our collective strength and unity will drive the transformation we seek.

Friends and Supporters–
As a fifth-generation native of eastern North Carolina, I share your values and love for this region. My unwavering commitment to our communities is as strong as ever. It's been an honor to serve, and I'm asking for your support to continue this journey together.
After returning home from my eight years of active duty service in the U.S. Air Force, my career has taken me from the classroom at East Carolina University to the pulpit as a minister, to the mayor of my hometown, and the capital in Raleigh as a state senator. Each role has deepened my commitment to our community and strengthened my resolve to fight for the people of eastern North Carolina.
Now, I am proud to bring my experience and dedication to Washington, D.C., and work on behalf of our district every day. My deep connection to this region drives me to advocate for common-sense policies that benefit us all.
That's why I'm running for a second term. With support from folks like you, we can win this race and continue to uplift eastern North Carolina. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/dd-web?refcode=fl_web_btn]
Thank you for your help and for being a vital part of this journey. Your support means the world to me.

| | I'm sure you've been grappling with Saturday's assassination attempt on Donald Trump (which tragically left one rally-goer dead and two more wounded), and you're not alone. But in this moment of darkness in our country, it's essential to emphasize: **in America, we must**** _always_****settle our differences in the public sphere of debate and at the ballot box —**** _never_****with violence.** We've seen for years now how normalizing violent rhetoric can quickly turn into real violence that leaves our communities feeling unsafe, and every elected official has a duty to disavow it. That's why it's never been more important to recognize what's at stake in this election. This November, voters will have two clear choices on the ballot. One vision builds on the progress we've made to level the playing field for working families, ensure corporations and the wealthy pay their fair share, and defend our fundamental rights and freedoms. The other vision on offer boils down to further rollbacks of reproductive freedom, cuts to retirement security, more tax handouts for the ultra-wealthy, and a belief that executive authority should have few – if any – safeguards. **I know which vision I'm going to spend the next three-and-a-half months working for.** Because this election is far from over. Our grassroots movement has won before against policies and values that are wildly out of step with the American people, and we can do it again. The decision Americans make at the ballot box this November will set the course of our country's future for generations to come. And no matter what, we will not give in to fear and hatred – we will rise above and make our country all the stronger for it. _Ron_ |

clean_body: | | | | I'm sure you've been grappling with Saturday's assassination attempt on Donald Trump (which tragically left one rally-goer dead and two more wounded), and you're not alone. But in this moment of darkness in our country, it's essential to emphasize: in America, we must alwayssettle our differences in the public sphere of debate and at the ballot box — neverwith violence. We've seen for years now how normalizing violent rhetoric can quickly turn into real violence that leaves our communities feeling unsafe, and every elected official has a duty to disavow it. That's why it's never been more important to recognize what's at stake in this election. This November, voters will have two clear choices on the ballot. One vision builds on the progress we've made to level the playing field for working families, ensure corporations and the wealthy pay their fair share, and defend our fundamental rights and freedoms. The other vision on offer boils down to further rollbacks of reproductive freedom, cuts to retirement security, more tax handouts for the ultra-wealthy, and a belief that executive authority should have few – if any – safeguards. I know which vision I'm going to spend the next three-and-a-half months working for. Because this election is far from over. Our grassroots movement has won before against policies and values that are wildly out of step with the American people, and we can do it again. The decision Americans make at the ballot box this November will set the course of our country's future for generations to come. And no matter what, we will not give in to fear and hatred – we will rise above and make our country all the stronger for it. body:
| | | Friend,

**My family's story is the American Dream story.** Many years ago, there was a little boy in Starkville, Mississippi who lived across the street from Mississippi State but couldn’t go there because he’s black. _Despite growing up in the Jim Crow South, he refused to let vulnerability become victimhood._ He paid his way through college, served honorably in Vietnam, and started a trucking company with one truck, one trailer and no excuses – hauling BEER back and forth between Detroit and Milwaukee. I grew up in awe of that story. Because it was my Dad’s story. He and my mother raised me – never telling me that this is a racist country. Even though they endured racism—it didn’t define the nation they loved. They taught me I could do anything I set my mind to. They taught me service before self. I went to West Point, became a Ranger-qualified Apache pilot, and flew 750 combat hours in Operation Iraqi Freedom. By the grace of God, I came home and helped grow my family’s business. **Now I have the honor of representing Michigan’s 10th Congressional District.** As a dad of three boys, my biggest concern right now— my biggest fear— is that children today will think that the American Dream is just a myth. **[Will you join me in restoring the American Dream for our children?](http://links.jjforcongress.com/u/click?_t=f784024d18db4d2d88c26e9627b85cc7&_m=8447e34481c842e1a60783dec77af848&_e=7aoftsjKeIWgsdsIGRf-j0q79zQWisGoPdjCWn8ymjId9CA5G0EarxQhVa0h94BOyMMX595YtcBo0WlTeasTa15Nk8Wa4Ki88vAB6Yfyqjg4E3vhcrhojRwyFm6lBN1U21Uzv6h-cq9R9dowVAObmTbLe9-vXgLW7ZgzLT6dEtGJrRkuGnoxhbMWGjuvsbLqJyYJb_isjF1KL7S3kFi_iU3UtmVkYz6M1ajIx3NhIBnAGEp43_Z1IFYk3pB-k-FVoomFjj2pYbqtaG8z-2gO9bcVeKWiQaEDko5qfH1bPGjO9Z6YCRLm8hSkMsEG53QG7sOnPvi_RzBRL3WxEQxcT7C4CNtsTCW28uWEtDNYTLw%3D)** ****

| A note from Russell...
The people of New Hampshire are ready for a change in our representation in Congress, whether it's rising energy costs, the broken southern border, or a lack of support for our men and women in law enforcement. New Hampshire families know that our current leadership in Washington is failing us and have forgotten the 'Live Free or Die' values that we all pride ourselves on in New Hampshire. We need a fresh voice who has the business and elected experience to change the status quo. United, we can defeat Chris Pappas and bring real change to Washington.
Thank you.
-Russell

United We Dream Action proudly endorses Raquel Terán for Congress in Arizona’s 3rd District. Raquel Terán understands our needs and lived experiences, and her track record as a community organizer and elected leader for over a decade in Arizona proves it. She spent that time fighting to protect our people against anti-immigrant attacks like the infamous SB 1070 ‘show me your papers’ law. In a close primary race where Terán is up against a conservative Democrat funded by the AIPAC, we need to back the candidate who will serve our interests, not pro-Israel interests. Raquel Terán has fought and will continue to fight for affordable healthcare for families, better wages for workers, and better schools for children! Our generation is ready for elected officials like her. What better way to spread the word about this pro-immigrant champion than inviting your friends and followers to join the party? 🎉Take a moment and share our exciting news on your favorite social media platform now: Our generation is not waiting on the sidelines to see how the future shapes up for us. 🙅🏽♀️ We’re building the future we envision. A future where we all have the freedom to move, the freedom to live in the places we call home, and the freedom to thrive — and when people like Raquel Terán are in office, we’re a step closer to our vision! I started my career in investigative journalism at 19 for one main reason: THEY LIE.

The media lies, governments lie, corporations lie . . . they all lie.

Having done this for 20 years, I rely on something other than instinct or intuition. I suppress emotional responses and rely on facts, sources, and verification.

As I was watching the rally in Pennsylvania and the assassination attempt on President Trump, I was in shock like you.

Friend, with our midnight deadline just hours away, I just have to ask:
**Can you spare $5 to keep Nevada and the Senate blue? **
**With less than four months to go before the general election****,** what we do right now will determine what happens in November. Take a look at some of these great submissions and get artistic this weekend! You don’t need to have any previous art experience to create an art piece that showcases how important the Owyhee Canyonlands are to you. I’m not artistically talented or skilled, and I’ll be creating my own artwork to submit! In case you forgot, **this contest is open to any age, skill level, and art form**. name: Yassamin Ansari
subject: This is a long email, but I've got something to say
body:
Blocking out the noise in these final two weeks
Hi Peter, it's Yassamin.
In less than two weeks, Arizonans will head to the polls to cast their votes in our primary elections. I can't believe we're already that close. When I launched this campaign 15 months ago, I couldn't imagine what this race would be like less than 15 days away.
And while I'm incredibly proud of how our campaign has grown, with my entire team of young, diverse, progressive, and mission-driven staffers coming together to work hour after hour, day after day, regardless of how tired and hot we are, to make sure every voter in AZ-03 hears our message and our vision.
I am also hurt by how ugly some elements of this race have become. When I ran for the Phoenix City Council and fought back against xenophobic, false attacks – and defeated them resoundingly - I thought that would be the end, I thought this Congressional campaign would be different. How could someone resort to such ugly tactics, that are demeaning to our democracy, again?
**Desperation. **
Those who come after me with these smear campaigns have always been desperate. They are desperate to block my progressive vision and the community we've built because it terrifies them. There is nothing these organizations hate more than a legislator who doesn't bend to them and their wealthy interests and instead, focuses on delivering results.
With only two weeks to go, I am reflecting on my disappointment with what so many have deemed acceptable in this campaign in the face of desperation. And I am painfully reminded that attacks like these will follow me wherever I go. From my childhood to my first city council race, to now, and after we win. Many of these people will never stop.
**But the good news is that I won't stop either.** Attacks like these are what fuel me and my community, they only unite us and make us stronger. That's why I'm asking you today, Peter, would you be willing to make a contribution to my campaign to help us have the resources necessary to defeat these xenophobic smears once more and win this race at the end of the month?
Here's the link:

Thank you for standing with me,

name: Gavin Newsom
subject: I understand many of you feel anxious about the election
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY CAMPAIGN FOR DEMOCRACY PAC
body:
I've said it before, and I will say it again, the outcome of this election is not something we can just sit back and witness.

Hey folks, Gavin Newsom here.
I've said it before, and I will say it again, the outcome of this election is not something we can just sit back and witness. It is something we must work toward ... something we must manifest.
I understand that many of you are feeling anxious about November. But we are not without agency in shaping the outcome.
Can we defeat Trump? Yes! The polls are all very close.
Can we hold the Senate? Yes! Democrats are leading in almost every race we have to win.
Can we take the House? Again, yes!
But none of our candidates working hard to get that done can do it alone.
I have been asked, in many races — from the presidential race, to Senate races, to House races, to campaign for Democrats running in close races.
We're talking about the fate and future of our democracy, this country and the world. They all need us right now, and so I will do as much of that as I can between now and November.
But I too cannot do it alone. And while I try to limit the fundraising asks I send, especially for myself, that is what I have to ask you to do today:

I understand that many of you are feeling anxious about November. But we are not without agency in shaping the outcome. Can we defeat Trump? Yes! The polls are all very close. Can we hold the Senate? Yes! Democrats are leading in almost every race we have to win. Can we take the House? Again, yes! But none of our candidates working hard to get that done can do it alone. I have been asked, in many races — from the presidential race, to Senate races, to House races, to campaign for Democrats running in close races. We're talking about the fate and future of our democracy, this country and the world. They all need us right now, and so I will do as much of that as I can between now and November. But I too cannot do it alone. And while I try to limit the fundraising asks I send, especially for myself, that is what I have to ask you to do today: If you 've stored your info with ActBlue, we'll process your contribution instantly: | | ** | | | | | | | ** The truth is, we all have our roles to play if Democrats are going to win this fall. That's the only way it's going to happen. If we are simply witnesses, we'll lose. When act, Democrats can win. \- Gavin Newsom

Kennedy Jr. delivers a powerful message of unity and healing. Speaking on "NewsNation Prime," he condemns the violence and urges Americans to come together in the face of tragedy.RFK Jr. emphasizes the need to view fellow citizens as Americans first, transcending political divisions. He calls on the nation to seize this moment as an opportunity for reflection and positive change, stating that it's our collective responsibility to bring order out of chaos and good out of evil. | | | ---|--- | []() | ---|--- | Shape Tomorrow with RFK Jr: Your Voice, Your Vote Contribute to a brighter future through action:🗳️ Secure ballot access for RFK Jr across the nation.💡 Volunteer for a campaign that represents your values.🌍 Build a more inclusive, united future together.🤝 Join forces with fellow advocates in your community.🎉 Be part of a movement that fights for all Americans. | | | RFK Jr. interviews Dr. Paul Heroux, an expert in bioelectric physics, to talk about the potential health hazards of electromagnetic radiation (EMR) from cell phones and Wi-Fi. He presents scientific evidence and regulatory issues surrounding EMR exposure and explains how it can affect cell metabolism. Their conversation also covers the potential weaponization of Wi-Fi technology and questions the necessity of 5G.Key Points: EMR can increase cancer risk and impact the blood-brain barrier EMR sensitivity affects 2-3% of the population Alternative technologies like fiber optic cables are safer options Why It Matters: By understanding EMR risks, you can take proactive steps in protecting your health and that of your loved ones in an increasingly wireless world. | | | ---|--- | []() | ---|--- RFK Jr. exposes the conflicts of interest between government regulators and the pharmaceutical industry, focusing on vaccine approval processes. He details how agency employees receive royalties from vaccines they approve. He argues this leads to agency capture by pharmaceutical companies, influencing drug approvals based on profit motives rather than public health concerns.Key Points: NIH (National Institute of Health) owns 50% of Moderna vaccine patent, sharing billions in profits FDA receives 50% of budget from regulated industries, compromising independence Media censorship hinders public awareness of these conflicts | | | ---|--- | []() | ---|--- | Demand an End to the Forever Wars For too long, our country has been entangled in foreign conflicts, sacrificing trillions of dollars and countless lives. Prioritize peace and end our involvement in all foreign wars. 2. Invest in our communities, not endless conflicts. 3. We do not want to split our supporters as our greatest strength on social media is in high numbers. Please come to this meeting prepared to help with an existing page or group.Commitment is about 30 minutes a day to admin a page or moderate a group or any amount of time to generally promote content.We will go over all the ways you can help even if its just occasionally and especially if you would like the honor of showcasing Kennedy's support in your state.This meeting will be heavy on demo with time for questions at the end. Please save your personal anecdotes til the very end so we can cover lots of territory. Please be prepared to take notes or open your social media account in another window or device so you can work along with the lesson.Thank you so much for this crucial support | | | ---|--- | []() | ---|--- Robert F. Kennedy Jr. addresses his supporters and farmers in Freeport, Maine, highlighting the importance of family farms and warning against the growing dominance of large food corporations. Speaking to over 200 attendees, he stresses the need to protect small-scale agriculture and maintain food sovereignty.RFK Jr.'s message resonates strongly with local farmers, with one attendee, Holly Arbuckle from Newcastle, expressing a deep emotional connection to his words. the horrific assassination attempt of Donald Trump on Saturday, Adam
wrote,

“I hope we can lower the temperature of political discourse and rededicate
ourselves to the peaceful competition of ideas.”

Unfortunately, just two days later, the Republican National Convention
gave the microphone to the MAGA leaders who strive to do the opposite.

On Monday, Marjorie Taylor Greene took the stage in Milwaukee, where she
spread baseless lies about President Biden and attacked immigrants and the
LGBTQ+ community with more dangerous rhetoric.

Rhetoric that has gone hand-in-hand with record-breaking highs in
anti-LGBTQ+ hate crimes and anti-Latino hate crimes, including the 2019 El
Paso Walmart mass shooting.

movement.”

Derek, that

birthright citizenship.

It’s clear that a party that uplifts Marjorie Taylor Greene, who spreads

# Get Ready to Vote in the Primary!
---
| Ballots for the Aug. 6 Primary Election will be mailed out tomorrow, July 19. Be sure to vote, and remind your friends and family to vote, too!
Here is Dr Garcia’s Video Voters’ Guide:
---
[](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=aea25bbeef&e=3ed3552a03)
| And [click here](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=fd7ae95127&e=3ed3552a03) to read Dr Garcia’s official candidate statement.
---
|
## _Information for Voters_
---
| You can find all information about the election [here at the Washington Secretary of State website](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=9fbd2caa8d&e=3ed3552a03).
If you’re not registered to vote or need to update your voter information, [click here](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=63e9142cf2&e=3ed3552a03).
To access the official VoteWA Voter Registration and Ballot Management Portal, which you can sign into if you are already registered to vote, [click here](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=3653a3c90e&e=3ed3552a03).
You can find all official drop box and voting center locations [here](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=b2b82857fb&e=3ed3552a03).
---
[](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=a278c097c5&e=3ed3552a03)
|
---
|
# Freedom From Fentanyl Walk is Underway!
---
| | | | | | | | | | | On Tuesday July 16, Dr Garcia started the six-day [Freedom From Fentanyl Walk](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=51cbe46643&e=3ed3552a03), which goes from central Washington to Seattle, at Big Pines Recreation Site in Kittitas County. We were honored to be joined by 4th District Congressman Dan Newhouse, a leader on fighting fentanyl.
---
| [](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=1613443389&e=3ed3552a03)
---
| We are averaging well over 20 miles per day. On Day One we walked to Ellensburg. Yesterday, Day Two, we ended in Cle Elum. And today we’ll finish in Easton. We are joined by, and will be joined by, many wonderful people, including former addicts, people who’ve lost loved ones to fentanyl poisoning and overdose, and advocates.
Yesterday we were honored to have Ginny Burton, a former meth and heroin addict who has transformed herself into an amazing force for change, start walking with us.
You can find all the details on our walk at [fentanylwalk.com](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=9389d2265e&e=3ed3552a03), which redirects you to our website at [garciaforwa.com/fentanyl-walk/](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=b5a17ce758&e=3ed3552a03)
---
| | | | | | | | | | [](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=65eb6098ba&e=3ed3552a03)
---
| | If you’re in the Seattle are, you’ll want to be a part of our historic walk across the I-90 bridge walkway on Sunday, July 21, for the final leg! Meet at 12:45pm on July 21 at the [Lid Park on Mercer Island, 2223 W Mercer Way, Mercer Island, WA 98040](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=92e5b6011a&e=3ed3552a03).
---
| | | | | | | | | | | We’ll end the walk on Sunday, July 21 at 2pm at the [East Portal Viewpoint in Seattle, 1400 Lake Washington Blvd S, Seattle WA 98144](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=27a0e97caf&e=3ed3552a03), with a gathering and media availability.
---
| [](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=f457f283e0&e=3ed3552a03)
---
| Here’s a video and photos from Day Two of the walk:
---
| | | | | | | | | | [](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=87fd78e414&e=3ed3552a03)
---
|
---
|
---
|
---
|
# Donate!
---
| There are so many things we can accomplish with new leadership in the U.S. Senate! Together, we can change the way we are governed and get Washington state back on track.
Please contribute to our campaign so we can take our message to the voters. [Your contribution of $100, $50, $25, $10 or even $5 will help us win in November!](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=7c096005fe&e=3ed3552a03)
---
[DONATE](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=6357ae13ef&e=3ed3552a03)

# Volunteer!
---
| Now that Primary voting is upon us, our campaign is really kicking into high gear. We need volunteers to help doorbell, make phone calls, and do other vital campaign work in your community.
Send us an email at [info@garciaforwa.com](mailto:info@garciaforwa.com?subject=Volunteer&body=) to join our mission to change Washington for the better and defeat Sen. Maria Cantwell in November!

Hello,
In 2022, no one gave my husband Adam Frisch a chance against Lauren Boebert.
Everywhere you looked, the political pundits were calling Colorado’s 3rd congressional district “Safe Republican” or “Solid R.”
Nate Silver’s FiveThirtyEight only gave Adam a 3% chance of defeating Boebert. They projected he’d lose by over 45,000 votes!
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89112000/486227139/1610638071?refcode=em20240718mid-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=4cb6f1c4-3345-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&recurring=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0Y2I2ZjFjNC0zMzQ1LWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Hjs6ZyOB0TaNI1tCQ7RTv5Seh0d7YZ_NgGM4iC3CHS0=)
In the end, though, the race went to a recount. **Lauren Boebert won by just 546 votes, and Adam lost the closest race in the entire country.**
Because here’s what their “models” and “forecasts” didn’t factor in: Adam put in the work. He traveled 24,000 miles in our red pickup truck to every corner of the district. He met thousands and thousands of voters – and he _listened_.

Dear friend, this is Greg Landsman - Democrat, and J.D. Vance’s representative in Congress.

As kids, J.D. Vance and I grew up near each other in Butler County, Ohio. Now, he’s my constituent in OH-01. And while our paths have crossed in many ways, our visions for our country could not be more different.

The recent assassination attempt of former President Trump has made one thing clear: we must come together to oppose the divisive and dangerous agenda he represents.

**But let me be clear: JD Vance is not a unity selection.** Mr. Vance’s track record speaks for itself: [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89112700/486229683/366454392?amount=10&refcode=em_fr_2024.07.18_b1_gl_all&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDg5NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyYTUwMTE1YS0zNjQ1LWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BK2xy_eAfipyHGzYKLj4e5YBMUAF6NWnbhAfrVBp4Co=) It’s the role Vance is playing in fanning the flames of political division that makes him uniquely unfit for this moment of national unity and shared purpose.

**So, I’m asking for your help. We are locked in a tough re-election battle in a toss-up district Democrats need to hold to keep House control.** If Trump and Vance win, that could be our last blue bulwark against a red trifecta in Washington.

Dear Peter,
We are thrilled to announce a major victory in our campaign for true democracy! The North Carolina Board of Elections has officially certified the We The People party, giving Robert F. Kennedy Jr. and Nicole Shanahan _certified ballot access in this critical swing state_.
This marks our second battleground state—following Michigan—where Kennedy’s ballot access has been officially secured. The board's decision is a testament to the hard work of our dedicated volunteers who collected nearly double the required signatures.
**Second Legal Win Against Democratic Lawyers**
In addition to securing ballot access in North Carolina, we’ve also achieved our second legal victory against the DNC's frivolous challenges. Following our triumph in Hawaii in April, we have maintained a perfect record in defeating the DNC’s attempts to block our progress.
**Our Growing Electoral Presence**
Our campaign is gaining unstoppable momentum:
* **Certified Ballot Access:** 10 states (California, Delaware, Hawaii, Michigan, Minnesota, New Mexico, North Carolina, Oklahoma, South Carolina, and Utah)
* **Signatures Submitted:** 14 states (Alaska, Colorado, Georgia, Illinois, Indiana, Nebraska, Nevada, New Jersey, New York, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Tennessee, Texas, and Washington)
* **Signatures Collected:** 4 states (Florida, Idaho, Iowa, and New Hampshire)
* **Total Electoral Votes Secured:** 390 electoral votes, representing 73% of the 538 total electoral votes nationwide.

**Your Support is Crucial**
These victories prove that we are on the right path, but we need your continued support to keep this momentum going.
The DNC has launched an unprecedented multi-million dollar campaign to stop us, but with your help, we can overcome every obstacle.

subject: Re: the bet I made with my team
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TIM SHEEHY FOR MONTANA
body:
On Tuesday evening, I spoke at the Republican National Convention. But before I took to the stage, I wrote to you that I had made a bet with my team that we could raise $15,000 before I delivered my speech. |
---

Fellow American,

On Tuesday evening, I spoke at the Republican National Convention. But before I took to the stage, **I wrote to you that I had made a bet with my team that we could raise $15,000 before I delivered my speech.**

dangerous.

| | I've spoken before about expanding the Senate map to ensure we hold the Democratic Senate Majority, and today I want to dive into the important Senate race in Texas. This year, we have a big opportunity to flip Texas blue, and it starts with the competitive Senate race between Democratic nominee Colin Allred and Ted Cruz. Texas has long been a red state, voting for a Republican president every year since 1980. **But in 2020, we saw something shift – Donald Trump only won the state by 6.5%, the narrowest margin since 1996!** Colin Allred is the real deal, and as a civil rights attorney, he knows what it takes to win the tough fights and deliver for the people. When he first ran for Congress in 2018 in the Dallas district he was born and raised in, he defeated a 22-year, entrenched Republican incumbent by seven points. Ted Cruz has proven time and again to be the single most divisive politician in Washington. One of the best ways to fight crime is to enact commonsense gun safety legislation
#

Friends -
During the Republican National Convention, there has been a lot of talk about a big rise in crime. New York Congresswoman Elise Stefanik called it “Biden’s violent crime crisis, fueled by Democrats.”
But what Republicans failed to mention is that according to new FBI data, violent crime is down 15 percent so far this year under President Biden’s leadership. In contrast, violent crime rose by over 30 percent under Donald Trump.
If Republicans are concerned about violent crime, then working across the aisle to end our nation’s gun violence crisis should be their number one priority. Instead, we have extreme members of the House and Senate who are **blocking** votes on lifesaving gun safety legislation—all for the sake of keeping the gun lobby happy.
One of the best ways to fight crime is to enact commonsense gun safety legislation. But if we want this to happen, we must replace gun lobby-backed elected officials with gun safety champions.

Dear Friend,
I hope this email finds you well. There is often debate about whether we live in a republic or a democracy, and understanding this distinction is crucial for our civic engagement and political discussions.
The United States is fundamentally a republic. This means we elect representatives to make decisions on our behalf, ensuring that the government is based on laws and not the whims of the majority.
Understanding this balance between republic and democracy helps us appreciate the complexities of our political system and the importance of participating in it. By being informed and engaged citizens, we uphold the values and principles that our nation was founded upon.

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Since 2021, I’ve proudly represented Missouri’s 1st Congressional District
in Congress, where I’ve championed Medicare for All, the Green New Deal,
the Unhoused Bill of Rights, equal rights for all, and reproductive
freedom. I am proud of our track record and I’m even prouder that we’ve
done it without taking a dime from corporate PACs or special interests.

Now, we’re going up against a self-proclaimed Democratic opponent who
claims to stand for “progressive values,” while being bankrolled by some
very questionable donors.

According to reports, our opponent has raked in over $65,000 from donors
who also contributed to Missouri's two Republican Senators, anti-abortion
insurrectionist Josh Hawley and Eric Schmitt... If I’m going to keep up with
the Republicans trying to buy this seat, we’re going to have to match them
dollar for dollar.
Peter, we
just increased our July grassroots fundraising goal to $65,000. [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240718-cb.afq-i0&refcode=em20240718-35775&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1001&akid=35775%2E1203867%2EhXY7Ns ]Can you
split a donation between my campaign and Justice Democrats to help send me
back to Congress, so I can keep fighting for our movement?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240718-cb.afq-i0&refcode=em20240718-35775&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1002&akid=35775%2E1203867%2EhXY7Ns ]HuffPost: Rep. Cori Bush’s Democratic Challenger Is Raising Big Bucks —
From Republicans

Our opponent has also accepted over $360,000 in individual contributions
earmarked as having been directed to his campaign through AIPAC and their
far-right Republican strategists.

It's clear that he is more interested in pleasing his wealthy donors than
standing up for the people of St. Louis. He's willing to sell out our
values for a quick buck, and that's something our communities can’t
afford. They deserve better.

But here's the good news: we have the power to fight back. By supporting
our grassroots campaign, you're standing up against a grifter politician
and the influence of big money in politics and demanding real
representation for the people of MO-01.

So, let's send a message loud and clear: we won't be bought and paid for
by special interests. We're fighting for a government that works for all
of us, not just the wealthy few, and we’re fighting back against the GOP
mega-donors attempting to buy their influence in our Democratic primaries.
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240718-cb.afq-i0&refcode=em20240718-35775&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1003&akid=35775%2E1203867%2EhXY7Ns ]Will you split a $5 donation or whatever you can afford
between my campaign and Justice Democrats to help us build a movement that
puts people over profits and prioritizes humanity back in Congress?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240718-cb.afq-i0&refcode=em20240718-35775&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1022&akid=35775%2E1203867%2EhXY7Ns ]Contribute $5

In solidarity,

Cori Bush

body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/engel-rgallego?refcode=X_071824_RGallegoEngel_act [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/engel-rgallego?refcode=X_071824_RGallegoEngel_act]
Peter, Kari Lake directly addressed the Republican National Convention.
She had a prime-time slot, one of the biggest of the night. I’m not going to speculate on how many people watched, but I can tell you one thing for sure: It was the biggest platform she’s ever had.
We always knew that this would be one of the closest races in the country. That’s no secret. * Mass deportations, including **deporting victims of human trafficking** (how cruel can they get?!), and;
* Defunding Planned Parenthood, banning abortion medication like mifepristone, and having government agencies conduct **“abortion surveillance”** on American citizens.

Over 100 far-right organizations contributed to the plan, and **they’ve openly stated their goal: turn America into a Christian nationalist state** ; a country that posts the 10 Commandments in classrooms but has a president who doesn’t follow any of them.
They say they’re defending “traditional family values” but that’s only if the tradition is Christian and the family is straight. Under Project 2025, if your family is gay, interracial, or Jewish like mine, then this country isn’t for you.

| [](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=c63c01b333&e=c0babbc643)

Please[ ](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=38c5c30833&e=c0babbc643)[join us](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=4febf959b7&e=c0babbc643) to learn how pets play a role in improving physical and mental well-being for kids, families and older adults at a special event my office is holding in partnership with the Peninsula Humane Society 4 p.m. to 6 p.m., Tuesday, July 23, 12 Airport Blvd., San Mateo. According to famed UK veterinarian _Dr. Marc Abraham OBE: “The_ _ _ inability to leave the house is a common symptom of loneliness, so having to walk a dog once or twice daily encourages outside physical fitness, lowers rates of obesity and increases the frequency and likelihood of real life human-human interactions.” At our [PHS event](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=38f78c0bfc&e=c0babbc643), you will learn how you can adopt your forever furry friend including dogs, cats, small animals and even exotic animals such as lizards, snakes and turtles [https://phs-spca.org/adopt/exotic-animals/](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=ba61060632&e=c0babbc643). This event launches the first of many in my office’s “Loneliness t o Light Series.” Abraham continues on the Campaign to End Loneliness blog: “Indeed, having a dog by your side is often the ultimate conversation starter, igniting connections, thus reducing feelings of social isolation. Staying home with a cat, rabbit, or any other furry or feathered friend also offers a degree of companionship and interaction, including fulfilling daily routines, which can all help support and manage long-term mental health issues such as depression, anxiety and loneliness.” [https://www.campaigntoendloneliness.org/the-importance-of-animals-tackling-loneliness-one-pet-at-a-time/](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=efcbcb1e28&e=c0babbc643) [_**RSVP HERE!**_](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=419c3a9f22&e=c0babbc643)

body:
|
Derek —
**[I’m writing to ask you to split a $10 contribution between my campaign for Congress and Adam Schiff’s campaign for Senate before our midnight deadline comes to a close.](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=july2024_abs_em_vindman.oB4iEN&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC90_20240718_PM1_V1_S1&email=amount%3D10&t=3&akid=7049%2E5257348%2E8Zafqp)**
Please give me just a minute to explain why:
In 2019, while serving on the National Security Council, my brother Alex heard a phone call wherein then-President Trump pressured Ukrainian President Zelenskyy to fabricate lies about Joe Biden as a quid pro quo for US military aid.
At the time I was the NSC’s lead ethics attorney. My brother alerted me of the call and we immediately informed our superiors. Alex eventually testified before a closed session of the House Intelligence Committee, on which Rep. Adam Schiff served as chair.
Adam Schiff led a thorough, honest investigation and eventually secured the first bipartisan vote in a Senate impeachment trial to convict a U.S. president in the history of our country.
Exposing Trump’s abuse of power was the right thing to do, Derek — but we all paid the price.
Trump fired Alex and me from our posts, and the GOP and right-wing media have spent every day since seeking to take down Adam Schiff — including trying to remove him from Congress — simply for championing the rule of law.
That’s why it’s up to us to have Adam’s back. Because he will always have our backs in the fight for our democracy.
Democracy is on the line this November, so it’s more important than ever that we have staunch voices who will stand in its defense in the Senate. Adam Schiff is one of those voices.
**[So please, split a contribution of $10 or whatever you can afford today between Adam’s campaign for Senate and my campaign for Virginia’s 7th district. Friend —
We’ll get right to the point: **The far right in Wisconsin has a long history of disenfranchising Black voters and rigging the rules to push democracy aside.**
They were even caught bragging about it.
So we must do everything in our power to ensure voters have all the help and resources they need to make it to the polls this November **and make sure their votes are counted**. And Mandela is leading that charge with organizations like Power to the Polls and Power to the Polls Federal Fund to do just that.
They are fundamentally changing what it means to organize in Black, Brown, and working class communities.
[**Will you please split a $5 contribution between Power to the Polls Federal Fund and The Long Run today? They were even caught bragging about it. So we must do everything in our power to ensure voters have all the help and resources they need to make it to the polls this November and make sure their votes are counted. And Mandela is leading that charge with organizations like Power to the Polls and Power to the Polls Federal Fund to do just that. Mandela’s team is already knocking on voters’ doors, showing up in the community to listen to voters’ concerns, and building the foundation necessary to ensure Black, Brown, and working class voters reach the polls in November. Wisconsin proved the power of high voter turnout last year when Justice Janet Protasiewicz won the Wisconsin Supreme Court race. And in 2024 we must do it again. Because without Wisconsin, we lose the White House and Senate majority. So, it's no secret that the voters we reach before election day will make all the difference. And if we continue to work together to get out the vote, we can ensure we hold the White House, reelect Tammy Baldwin, and help every Democrat on the ballot win in November. subject: JD is a Leader We DONT Deserve
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
We’re ready for change, Peter.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20240718&t=1&akid=957%2E587540%2EDMphps)
Peter, Donald Trump announced his pick for Vice President: **J.D. Vance.**
[****](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240718?refcode=em20240718&refcode2=957_587540_DMphps&akid=957%2E587540%2EDMphps)
Vance has become the first millennial _ever_ on a national ticket during an election where candidate age is top-of-mind for voters. But being young isn’t good enough.
Vance stands **against** critical issues that young people overwhelmingly support like protecting abortion, tackling the climate crisis, and passing gun reform. He’s a far-right extremist and MAGA militant that is even worse for young people than Trump. It’s a clear sign that the GOP is looking to the future and raising a new right to succeed them. _**Not on our watch.**_
We need to elect young people who are committed to bold progressive values and will fight for our generation. _We don’t need more young people like J.D. Vance in power._ We need more young people like **Ashwin Ramaswami, Nate Douglas, Anna Thomas, and Oscar De Los Santos instead.**
One of these young leaders could be president by 2050, which is why it's important that we set the stage now for a young, progressive candidate to lead the country. If far-right extremists can plan ahead to destroy the country with Project 2025, we can plan ahead to save it with Project 2050.
There’s no excuse now: if even Donald Trump and the GOP can invest in the next generation of leaders, so can progressives. Our entire future is at stake if we don’t. That’s why we’re doing the work here at Leaders We Deserve.
**[Peter, we aren’t waiting for the Democratic Party to invest in the next generation. It’s up to us to make change happen _now_. Can you give $5 to support our work in electing young leaders to offices across all levels of the government?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240718?refcode=em20240718&amount=5&refcode2=957_587540_DMphps&akid=957%2E587540%2EDMphps)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240718?amount=5&refcode=em20240718-957&refcode2=957_587540_DMphps&akid=957%2E587540%2EDMphps)**
For decades, Democrats have fallen behind in their efforts to invest in the next generation of leaders across the country.
We founded Leaders We Deserve a year ago to elect young leaders who have a stake in our futures. We’re proud of our success:
**→** We invested $100,000 in Nadarius Clark’s campaign, who was running in one of the most competitive races in Virginia for the state legislature. With our support, **Nadarius won and became the youngest Democrat ever elected to the Virginia General Assembly. His win secured Democrats a 1 seat majority that enabled him to kill a bill to arm teachers as the head of the firearms and public safety committee _(It was awesome. I, David, who’s editing this email, saw it happen. He also passed a gun safety law that the Republican governor signed into law.)_**
**→** Just this year, we invested $300,000 in Molly Cook’s campaign, got her on MSNBC, led volunteers in Houston who knocked over 2,000 doors, setting the stage for her to hold on to her seat in the Texas Senate in the November election. **Molly is now the youngest, most progressive, and first openly LGBT member of the Texas Senate.**
It’s past time for Democrats to step up their efforts in investing in the leaders of tomorrow. We’re ready for representatives that understand why the younger generations are so anxious about our futures.
**[Peter, we’ve been able to invest in young leaders with a tremendous amount of grassroots support. We don’t take corporate money nor do our candidates. With a critical election ahead of us in November, it's more important than ever that we elect young, progressive candidates to office. If you’re with us, can you support our work by giving $5 right now?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240718?refcode=em20240718&amount=5&refcode2=957_587540_DMphps&akid=957%2E587540%2EDMphps)**

Thank you for your support,
Leaders We Deserve

Hi there, it’s Michael.
The Republican National Convention this week has been a reminder of what's at stake in this election. When Republicans at the RNC talk about “making America great again,” they mean seizing power and implementing Project 2025.
Trump’s closest allies created the Project 2025 plan with the Heritage Foundation, an ultra-conservative think tank. They designed this four-pronged proposal to consolidate Trump’s power, attack our fundamental freedoms and rights, and undermine our democracy.
Starting on Day One of the new Trump administration, Project 2025 would reshape the federal government by mass-firing current federal employees, replacing them with approved Trump allies, and implementing extremist policies.
It includes nearly 900 pages of policy suggestions. These are some of the most terrifying:

# Take your Health Back!
UPDATE SINCE OUR THERAPY:
Friends and Family,
Many of you have heard about Nena’s remarkable health transformation since she underwent Stem Cell Therapy. Her journey has been nothing short of miraculous. Her cancer, once at a daunting stage 5, has moved to stage 1. The wrinkles around her eyes have vanished, her hair has regrown in its original color, her eyesight has been restored to a perfect 20/20, and her energy levels have soared. She has even seen her insulin intake drop from 175 units a day to under 25. Her story is an incredible testament to the power of this therapy and she is still being healed daily.
But today, I want to share my own testimony. Six weeks ago, I underwent this therapy, and the results have been nothing short of amazing. For years, I’ve suffered from chronic pain due to being bone-on-bone in my knees. This pain often led me to rely on narcotic pain medications and even walk with a cane. I was even granted permanent disability because of it. But just four days after the therapy, my knee pain completely disappeared. I have spent hours on my knees over the past five weeks, and the pain has not returned. My memory has cleared, my skin has cleared up, and my energy levels have skyrocketed.
We are beyond excited about what God has done through this therapy, and we want to share this incredible opportunity with you. This is not a pyramid scheme or an MLM. It is a Christian-owned and operated company based in Texas, and Nena and I have spent hours fellowshipping with the owners. We believe in this therapy with all our hearts, and we want you to experience its transformative power.
Don’t miss this opportunity. We will be holding a seminar with a free dinner for you to learn about this amazing, God-given therapy. Join us on Tuesday, the 23rd, in Torrance, California, and Wednesday, the 24th, in Modesto, California. Email me at officialderrickgates@gmail.com to register. This is your moment. Don’t let it pass you by.
Let's embrace this journey of transformation together!
Tag those that you think would benefit from this.
With gratitude and excitement,
Derrick & Nena
To attend our Los Angeles Free Dinner on July 23rd in Torrance at 7pm or Modesto on July 24th at 7pm, please email me at officialderrickgates@gmail.com
Previous Message:
Alright, everybody, strap in because I've got something absolutely mind-blowing to share with you, especially all my folks in California and the surrounding areas. This is not your average health benefit – we're talking about a game-changer!
Now, I've been through the wringer when it comes to health. Yeah, I shed a whopping 500 pounds recently, but guess what? The battle's far from over. My body's still screaming in pain, and I'm staring down the barrel of two knee replacements. Back and hips? They're on a constant pain playlist, and the list of issues just keeps growing.
So, what do you do when the traditional pharmaceutical game doesn't cut it? You dig deep, you research, and you look for alternatives. And let me tell you, my skepticism led me to a revelation that's going to blow your minds!
About a month back, my buddy of 20 years, Pastor James Fortune, hit me up with news that changed the game for him and his wife, Canada. They discovered a treatment so good, it sounds too good to be true. But hold on – it's legit! We're talking medical documents, x-rays, blood tests – the whole nine yards.
I practically dragged Pastor James Fortune to Los Angeles because I knew you needed to hear this. We're hosting him at not one, but two locations in LA County. Picture this: an amazing catered dinner on us, and all the info you need to make educated decisions about taking charge of your health and living your absolute best life right now.
Don't procrastinate until your body breaks down even more. It's time to restore your youth, break free from the pain, and live the life you've been dreaming of. This is your shot, my friends – seize it!
To attend our Los Angeles Free Dinner on July 23rd in Torrance at 7pm or Modesto on July 24th at 7pm, please email me at officialderrickgates@gmail.com

### And your annual refresher on vibrio safety
Jul 18
---
